items.displayType: Formed when sap from the Beraber Fir is crystalized during forest fires, this transparent deep blue "gemstone" is often polished smooth and used in jewelry. While it can be manufactured by growing trees and then doing a controlled burn, the time investment for the trees to reach the proper maturity still make this a rare commodity.

items.name: Carinite
items.displayType: A rare mineral because the extreme pressure needed for its formation is very uncommon, it is in high demand thanks to its use in advanced computer processors and other cutting-edge electronics.

items.name: Feynmaline
items.displayType: The paramorphic crystalline structure of this mineral is extremely volatile. When extra energy is introduced, as is typical with modern mining, the ore will often explosively degrade into the more stably structured Janalite. This instability makes Feynamline very dangerous to acquire but also extremely valuable as an industrial anti-matter precursor if it can be properly harvested.

items.name: Glacosite
items.displayType: As glaciers form, heavier mineral contents sink over time and are then crushed by the weight above as the ice deforms and flows. When the glacier recedes, Glacosite deposits are left behind. White and blue in color, the crystals form in long shiny strands that almost are cotton-like in appearance. Glacosite has found specialized commercial use since it is an extremely light and durable insulator.

items.name: Jaclium (Ore)
items.displayType: A naturally occurring rare metal form of jahlium, it is used in the production of extremely strong alloys with incredible tensile strength. Originally confused with common jahlium when first discovered, the above average results when used lead to researchers to realize its value.

items.name: Saldynium (Ore)
items.displayType: A rare metal that has traditionally been extremely difficult to find in large quantities owing to the particular environmental requirements for its formation. It is sought after for its use in the production of high-powered lasers. It also shows some antimicrobial properties though its scarcity has seen it used less for medical purposes.

items.name: Year of the Pig Envelope
items.displayType: A gilded red envelope celebrating the Year of the Pig. Exchanging these envelopes is one of the most popular ways of celebrating Red Festival. Often the envelope may include a small amount of credits inside to help those you care about have a strong start in the upcoming cycle. Growing in popularity is the newer tradition of hiding the envelopes as a way of spreading good fortune and prosperity to those that fate has deemed in need.

items.name: Kopion Horn
items.displayType: The horn of the kopion is made of a unique combination of bone and naturally-occurring carbon nanomaterials. When properly processed, it can be used to aid in bone regeneration with a far greater rate of success than lab-grown materials. This application has made it a valuable commodity.

items.name: Marok Gem
items.displayType: The marok has a gizzard, which takes food that has been previously swallowed from the stomach and "chews" it before passing it back into the stomach to be digested. To help this process, the marok's body secretes a substance that hardens into a large crystalline stone that stays in the gizzard and helps food get pulverized more efficiently. The stone has unique conductive properties that make it sought-after for use in computer chips.

Luminalia Gift
items.displayType: A small, wrapped package meant to get you in the Luminalia spirit. Banu merchants celebrating the holiday used to hide small gifts aboard their ship to encourage revelers to explore all their wares. As the holiday grew in popularity within the UEE, Human merchants modified this tradition by hiding empty gift-wrapped packages around a space station or landing zone that could be exchanged for credits if returned unopened. The increased foot traffic into their stores spurned holiday sales and became a tradition in its own right. \n\nStow this gift for sentimental value, or sell it at a commodities terminal and spend the credits on a holiday gift for yourself.

items.name: Year of the Dog Envelope
items.displayType: A gilded red envelope celebrating the Year of the Dog. Exchanging these envelopes is one of the most popular ways of celebrating Red Festival. Often the envelope may include a small amount of credits inside to help those you care about have a strong start in the upcoming cycle. Growing in popularity is the newer tradition of hiding the envelopes as a way of spreading good fortune and prosperity to those that fate has deemed in need.

missions.name: HighpointWildernessSpecialists_KillAnimals_Easy_NoRep
missions.title: Reduce Overpopulation
missions.description:
We’ve been monitoring a situation at [LOCATION] regarding an uptick in the [CREATURE] population over the past few months. Our models indicate that if this continues many of the native plants and animals will be adversely affected. It’s imperative that the [CREATURE] population is reduced before that happens.     

If you can help, please refer to "The Guide to Stanton Wildlife" in your Journal for more specifics on the targeted creature.

Best,

Wanda Werkheiser
Contract Manager
Highpoint Wilderness Specialists

missions.name: HighpointWildernessSpecialists_KillAnimals_Medium_NoRep
missions.title: Cull Invasive Creatures
missions.description:
Highpoint Wilderness Specialists are dedicated to keeping the delicate ecosystems of the empire in balance. A client recently hired us to evaluate the environmental impact of a number of invasive creatures near [LOCATION]. We’ve determined that to preserve the natural order of the region a conscientious culling of these species is necessary.  

Looking for someone able and willing to help in this effort. Please refer to "The Guide to Stanton Wildlife" in your Journal for further information on the creatures being targeted.     

Best,

Wanda Werkheiser
Contract Manager
Highpoint Wilderness Specialists

missions.name: HighpointWildernessSpecialists_KillAnimals_Hard_NoRep
missions.title: Intensive Eradication Effort
missions.description:
Native plants and animals near [LOCATION] are on the verge of environmental collapse due to the dramatic population spikes of several invasive species. We’ve been contracted to dramatically reduce the current population of these species to help avoid an environmental collapse. We need a dedicated and highly skilled exterminator to carry out this contract.     

You can better acquaint yourself with the creatures in question by referencing "The Guide to Stanton Wildlife" in your Journal.     

Best,

Wanda Werkheiser
Contract Manager
Highpoint Wilderness Specialists

missions.name: HighpointWildernessSpecialists_IrradiatedKopions_RegionA_KillAnimals
missions.title: Cull Irradiated Kopions
missions.description:
As a consequence of the ongoing radiation storm on Pyro I, some of the invasive kopions have become irradiated. This poses a threat to the health of the indigenous wildlife and to those who live and work in [LOCATION]. 

We are seeking out a skilled contractor who can cull any irradiated kopions in and around [LOCATION]. Do not accept this contract unless you have the proper weapons and equipment that can reliably function in a radioactive environment. 

Your compensation will be adjusted to match the risks associated with this contract.

Best,

Wanda Werkheiser
Contract Manager
Highpoint Wilderness Specialists

missions.name: HighpointWildernessSpecialists_KillAnimals_Nyx_Easy
missions.title: Reduce Valakkar Breaker Station Population
missions.description:
If you have any work that's going to be bringing you to one of those old QV Breaker Stations in the Keeger Belt, we have something else that we could use your help on while you're there.
 
We've recently been contacted by the People's Alliance to assist with an initiative to help prepare these abandoned stations for repairs. Unfortunately, a Valakkar infestation is creating serious problems for not only the stations' infrastructure, but also for the chances of them being brought back online one day. Due to Valakkar's status as an invasive species, we have decided that culling them is the only viable option.
 
Reduce the Valakkar numbers at any of the old QV Breaker Stations and we will offer you payment.
 
Best,
 
Wanda Werkheiser

Contract Manager

Highpoint Wilderness Specialists

missions.name: HWS_Pyro_RegionA_E_DerelictOutposts_KillAnimals
missions.title: Pack of Kopions Threatening CFP
missions.description:
Highpoint Wilderness is seeking a contractor to cull a pack of kopions that are threatening to overrun one of Citizens for Prosperity's outposts. After an initial assessment, it has been decided that relocation is impossible and a culling of them is the only viable option. If you're interested, head to [LOCATION]  and once we've received confirmation that the task is complete we will send payment.

Best,

Wanda Werkheiser
Contract Manager
Highpoint Wilderness Specialists

missions.name: HWS_Pyro_RegionA_E_DerelictOutposts_NearOutposts_KillAnimals
missions.title: Overpopulated Kopions Need Exterminating
missions.description:
Highpoint Wilderness needs someone to exterminate an overpopulated pack of kopions that's threatening one of CFP's settlements. This pack can be found at [LOCATION]. Remember to exhibit caution when approaching them and arm yourself accordingly.

Best,

Wanda Werkheiser
Contract Manager
Highpoint Wilderness Specialists

missions.name: CFP_Pyro_RegionA_M_DerelictOutposts_NearOutposts_KillAnimals
missions.title: Protect CFP Members from Overactive Kopions
missions.description:
Citizens for Prosperity have approached us with information that multiple groups of kopions have been attacking people at [LOCATION] without provocation. Currently, no deaths have been reported, but they are concerned their most vulnerable will be at risk if these kopions continue running rampant.

Ensure you are prepared adequately, kopions hunt in packs and it is easy to become overwhelmed by their sheer numbers.

Best,

Wanda Werkheiser
Contract Manager
Highpoint Wilderness Specialists

missions.name: CFP_Pyro_RegionB_M_Derelicts_EliminateAnimals
missions.title: Overaggressive Kopions Need Removing
missions.description:
Citizens for Prosperity recently reported to us that one of their scouts was injured by kopions during a routine exploration mission. According to them, this isn't the first time this particular pack has posed a problem, so they've requested our services to clear out the area. The report shows they were last seen at [LOCATION].

This behavior is typical of kopions looking to expand their territory, so it is highly likely that you will be dealing with more kopions than initially observed. Caution is advised. 

Best,

Wanda Werkheiser
Contract Manager
Highpoint Wilderness Specialists

missions.name: CFP_Pyro_RegionB_H_Derelicts_EliminateAnimals
missions.title: Protect Settlement from Kopion Packs
missions.description:
Members of the group Citizens for Prosperity were recently ambushed by several packs of kopions at [LOCATION] and have requested Highpoint's services in dealing with them. For the safety of everyone trying to settle in the area, we require the immediate services of someone who can deal with this on our behalf.

Expect a large number of animals and prepare yourself accordingly.

Best,

Wanda Werkheiser
Contract Manager
Highpoint Wilderness Specialists

missions.name: CFP_Pyro_RegionC_Caves_E_KillAnimals
missions.title: Kopion Culling for CFP
missions.description:
We’re putting out a contract for anyone who is capable of hunting animals responsibly. Citizens for Prosperity needs a group of aggressive kopions who have been harassing their people culled from [LOCATION]. After some initial monitoring, it looked as if they may on, but unfortunately we’ve been forced to take action. This is a relatively straightforward job, but when dealing with dangerous animals, cautious is always advised.

Best,

Wanda Werkheiser
Contract Manager
Highpoint Wilderness Specialists

missions.name: Rayari_Intro
missions.title: Interested in Building a Better Future?
missions.description:
To all available contractors,

Rayari Incorporated is looking for independent contractors to provide additional support in our efforts to push the boundaries of science, agriculture, and medicine in the Empire and beyond. 

A research initiative at [DESTINATION] is in desperate need of resources, so we are looking for a reliable contractor to obtain and deliver these crucial components.

For more information on the animals in question, refer to "The Guide to Stanton Wildlife" in your Journal.

Rayari offers competitive wages along with the knowledge that you're building a better universe.

Let’s grow together,

Narina Lerrem
Senior Manager
Clinical Research Outsourcing

missions.name: Rayari_Rank0_Harvestable_Single_Prota
missions.title: Additional Resources For Research
missions.description:
To all available contractors,

Rayari scientists are hard at work trying to solve the issues with failing regen tech. Currently, their efforts are hindered by a lack of materials which they believe could be essential for their experiments.  

In particular, our scientists at [DESTINATION] have had to put their work on hold after running out of those resources. With a restock from our normal provider not possible for months owing to short supply, we’ll pay a premium to anyone who can assist with restocking the materials.

For more information on the animals in question, refer to "Explorer's Guide to Harvestables" in your Journal.

Together we can make the universe better for all.

Narina Lerrem
Senior Manager
Clinical Research Outsourcing

missions.name: Rayari_Rank1_Gems_Single_Saldynium
missions.title: Need Resource for Research
missions.description:
To all available contractors,

Our research team at at [DESTINATION] is working tirelessly on solving the current ‘Regen Crisis’ and addressing the issue of unstable imprints. Their work has produced promising results, but a lack of a key resource is impeding their ability to run further experiments. 

We’ve received word from our supplier that increased demand combined with lower mining yields means that we won’t receive our scheduled shipment for another few months. Our research team can’t wait that long, and we’re hoping you can help.      

The resource is hard to come by, but we have it on good authority that the old Hathor mining facilities were built in areas with a high concentration of the ore. Since Hathor went defunct not long after establishing their operations in- system, there’s a good chance that activating one of these mining lasers could provide you with what we need.

Together we can make the universe better for all.

Narina Lerrem
Senior Manager

missions.name: GoblinG_ResourceGathering_Intro
missions.title: RESOURCE DRIVE: HAULER REQUIRED
missions.description:
HURSTON DYNAMICS OUTSOURCING
CONTRACT: Resource Drive
OUTSOURCE MANAGER: A. Carmichael
RISK ASSESSMENT: Low

To solve the regen crisis, the Empire has put out a call for resources and Hurston Dynamics intends to answer. Whichever company donates the most wins government sponsored benefits, and we have no intention of losing.

As a first assignment, you are being tasked with making a small cargo delivery. More lucrative and complex work will follow the successful completion of this contract.

This assignment requires a ship that can carry [MISSION MAX SCUSIZE] cargo containers and a multi-tool with a tractor beam attachment. Once you finished your preparations, head to [LOCATION], collect the cargo from the freight elevator, and deliver it to a freight elevator at: [DESTINATION].

The Second Life initiative requires us to publicly declare Hurston’s contributions. This information, along with the other corporations' contributions is available in the Second Life Resource Drive section of your Journal. Be aware that milestone bonuses are available for contractors who fulfil delivery quotas.


** The information transmitted may contain confidential and/or privileged material. Any review, retransmission, dissemination or other use of or taking action in reliance upon this information by persons or entities other than the intended recipient is prohibited. **

missions.name: GoblinG_ResourceGathering
missions.title: RESOURCE DRIVE: MATERIALS REQUIRED
missions.description:
HURSTON DYNAMICS OUTSOURCING
CONTRACT: Resource Drive
OUTSOURCE MANAGER: A. Carmichael
RISK ASSESSMENT: Low

Hurston’s mission isn’t complete yet.

We need every available SCU of the following refined resources in order to secure Hurston’s win of the UEE’s Second Life Resource Drive. Demand for them is so high, they are no longer available in shops and must be first mined. In the interest of efficiency, we’ve listed their most common locations in proximity to our processing plant along with the price you'll recieve: 

- Copper (surface of Aberdeen) - 803 aUEC per SCU
- Tungsten (surface of Lyria) - 1080 aUEC per SCU
- Corundum (asteroids near HUR-L2) - 810 aUEC per SCU

Once you’ve mined the materials, you'll need to refine them. I recommend HUR-L1 Green Glade Station. Take the completed resources to a freight elevator at: [DESTINATION]. Submit the contract when you’re satisfied with the total amount you’ve provided.

Additional guidance on mining can be found under URW's “The Fundamentals of Mining” section of your mobiGlas Journal.

To help you realize what’s at stake here, you can see every company’s contribution in the Second Life Resource Drive section of your Journal. Remember that Hurston Dynamics rewards those who serve the company’s interests well.


** The information transmitted may contain confidential and/or privileged material. Any review, retransmission, dissemination or other use of or taking action in reliance upon this information by persons or entities other than the intended recipient is prohibited. **

missions.description:
HURSTON DYNAMICS OUTSOURCING
CONTRACT: Resource Drive
OUTSOURCE MANAGER: A. Carmichael
RISK ASSESSMENT: Moderate

According to our trackers, an important shipment of cargo appears to have stopped moving over at [LOCATION].

The pilot isn’t answering, so we assume they’ve been compromised. My superiors have written this off as a loss, but if any of the materials can be recovered, we are prepared to compensate you. Any standard tractor beam should be fine to facilitate the transfer of cargo to your ship after any hostile ships have been dealt with. Expect to find between 50-55 SCU of various box sizes.

Bring what you find to a freight elevator at: [DESTINATION]. I’ll send a member of our team to inspect them.

If the abandoned vessel is still intact, and you have an available pilot with you, you could avoid having to transfer that cargo and just fly it back.

Procure a heavy-duty tractor beam, head out to [LOCATION] and deliver the recovered cargo to a freight elevator at: [DESTINATION]. A member of our team will ensure it gets to the right people.

missions.name: HaulCargo_AToB_Interstellar_Small_SunB_GolDMed_Intro
missions.title: Cargo Hauling Opportunity with Ling Hauling
missions.description:
Hi,  
 
This is Petra Ling, and I’m proud to offer you a new and exciting opportunity to partner with Ling Family Hauling. When my parents started this company, their goal was to provide fast and reliable courier deliveries around the greater Crusader area. It quickly became a success, and as our reputation grew, so did our operations.  
 
Now, under my stewardship, Ling Family Hauling is taking the next big step – cargo hauling. Demand for this new service is growing faster than I expected, and that’s great news for both of us.   
 
If you’ve ever wanted to be a hauler, then I can make your dreams come true. Best way to learn something is by doing it, and I’ve got a haul of [ITEM] that needs to go from [LOCATION] to [DESTINATION].  

No prior experience is necessary, but here’s a few things to keep in mind. All pick-ups and deliveries must be done at a freight elevator or autoloaded. You will need a ship that can hold [MISSION MAX SCUSIZE] cargo containers, and a handheld tractor beam to move them around. 
 
Upon successful completion of this delivery, you will be promoted to a ‘trusted contractor’ status and more hauls will become available to you.     

 
Sincerely,  
Petra Ling  
Managing Director of Cargo Operations 
Ling Family Hauling 

 

 

 

Ling Family Hauling knows it’s a dangerous and unpredictable universe and has established several protocols to protect both you and our client’s cargo. To ensure you aren’t punished for circumstances outside of your control, total payment will be prorated to the percentage of cargo successfully delivered. A delivery timer will be set for each haul. Any cargo that remains undelivered upon its expiration will be flagged as stolen and treated as such. All pick-ups and deliveries must be autoloaded or done at a freight elevator.

missions.title: Inmate Maintenance Opportunity
missions.description:
Hello Guests,

We have recently been alerted that one of our Oxygen Dispensers has suffered a technical error. As you know these kiosks are vital to ensure that you have plenty of oxygen handy while participating in our Work Release Program.

We are looking for any available guest to reset the kiosk. That should reconnect the kiosk to the network and resolve the issue. The first guest who's able to complete this task will not only be compensated with merits, but also with the satisfaction that they're making the workplace safer for other guests.

Thank you.

missions.name: CFP_Pyro_RegionA_M_HHOutposts_Sabotage
missions.title: Destroy Headhunter Stolen Data
missions.description:
The Headhunters recently attacked one of our transports and were sadly able to get their hands on some secure data. Although the encryption on it is strong, its only a matter of time before they'll be able to access it.

Before that happens, we need you to go to [LOCATION] and destroy all traces of the information from their servers.

You'd really be helping Citizens for Prosperity out if you can pull this off.
 
Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity

missions.name: CFP_Pyro_RegionA_M_Rustville_Sabotage
missions.title: Take Outlaws at [LOCATION] Offline
missions.description:
We have gotten word that the outlaws at [LOCATION] have begun recruiting with the hopes of launching a raid against Citizens for Prosperity. 

In order to deescalate the situation before it gets out of hand, we would like you to disable their power generators and halt their expansion. 

Pull this off and it could save a lot of lives.
 
Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity

missions.name: CFP_Pyro_RegionA_VH_LastDitch_Sabotage
missions.title: Destroy Outlaw Data Servers
missions.description:
Citizens for Prosperity have been monitoring a very dangerous outlaw group at [LOCATION] and we believe that they are in midst of planning a major attack which could throw the whole system into upheaval.

In order to protect all the progress we've made here, we would like you to raid their compound and destroy all the servers housing their plans. 

This should at least provide us with enough of a reprieve for them to reconsider their offensive.

Thank you,
 
Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity

missions.name: CFP_Pyro_RegionD_XTOutpost_Sabotage
missions.title: Destroy XenoThreat Logistic Data
missions.description:
We got a bit of a problem that I'm hoping you can solve for me. One of our informers has revealed that XenoThreat has been amassing data on Citizens for Prosperity operations throughout the system. 

This information, if used correctly, could put our people at serious risk. The best solution is for you to completely destroy the servers where the data is being stored at [LOCATION].

With their trove of information wiped out, it should give our people a fighting chance.
 
Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity

missions.name: CFP_Pyro_RegionA_Rank0_VE_1AsteroidBase_Criminals_Sabotage
missions.title: Disable Outlaw Stronghold at [LOCATION]
missions.description:
Following a series of raids against Citizens for Prosperity aligned settlements, we believe we have traced those responsible back to [LOCATION].

Attacking them directly will pose too great of a risk and most likely encourage aggressive reprisals. Instead, we believe that if their power generators were to be disable it could force them to settle somewhere else.

Do you think you could handle it for us?
 
Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity

missions.name: CFP_Pyro_RegionD_VE_1AsteroidBase_Criminals_Sabotage
missions.title: Disable Outlaw Stronghold at [LOCATION]
missions.description:
Following a series of raids against Citizens for Prosperity aligned settlements, we believe we have traced those responsible back to [LOCATION].

Attacking them directly will pose too great of a risk and most likely encourage aggressive reprisals. Instead, we believe that if their power generators were to be disable it could force them to settle somewhere else.

Do you think you could handle it for us?
 
Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity

missions.name: CFP_Pyro_RegionD_E_1AsteroidBase_Criminals_BombingRun
missions.title: Eliminate Fuel Stores
missions.description:
We've been having escalating issues with the outlaws at [LOCATION] and can no longer stand by and watch as their aggressive actions hurt our community. 

We are wary of launching a full scale assault, but believe that if their fuel stores are wiped out, it would deter them from further hostile actions. 

If you're able, I'd appreciate you handling the destruction of the fuel personally. A ship capable of launching missiles would probably make the most sense, but I leave that up to you.

Thanks,
 
Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity

missions.name: CFP_Pyro_RegionB_M_HHOutposts_Sabotage
missions.title: Destroy Headhunter Stolen Data
missions.description:
The Headhunters recently attacked one of our transports and were sadly able to get their hands on some secure data. Although the encryption on it is strong, its only a matter of time before they'll be able to access it.

Before that happens, we need you to go to [LOCATION] and destroy all traces of the information from their servers.

You'd really be helping Citizens for Prosperity out if you can pull this off.
 
Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity

missions.name: CFP_Pyro_RegionB_VH_XTOutposts_Sabotage
missions.title: Destroy XenoThreat Data Servers
missions.description:
One of the Citizens for Prosperity members who have been serving as a XenoThreat informer has let us know that the data servers located at [LOCATION] our housing a trove of information vital to the gang's operation. 

If you were able to destroy these servers on our behalf it would be a huge win for the security of the entire system.
 
Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity

missions.name: CFP_Pyro_RegionB_H_XTXSOutposts_Sabotage
missions.title: Destroy XenoThreat Logistic Data
missions.description:
We got a bit of a problem that I'm hoping you can solve for me. One of our informers has revealed that XenoThreat has been amassing data on Citizens for Prosperity operations throughout the system. 

This information, if used correctly, could put our people at serious risk. The best solution is for you to completely destroy the servers where the data is being stored at [LOCATION].

With their trove of information wiped out, it should give our people a fighting chance.
 
Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity

missions.name: CFP_Pyro_RegionA_M_2AsteroidBase_Criminals_BombingRun_Sabotage
missions.title: Reduce Outlaw's Operational Readiness
missions.description:
There is a group of outlaws at [LOCATION] that have become increasingly brazen in their attacks on Citizens for Prosperity assets in the system. 

To minimize loss of life, we want to first try convincing them to move on to somewhere else by disabling their generators and destroying their fuel reserves. 

Hopefully, that should be enough to convince them to move on to greener pastures.

Thanks,
 
Lima Endicott

missions.title: Eradicate All Traces of Headhunter Data
missions.description:
We're just putting the full picture together now, but so far we've learned that a Headhunter by the name of [TARGET NAME] recently stole some sensitive data that if exposed will be detrimental to Citizens for Prosperity's cause. 

We need to ensure that all traces of the stolen data are eradicated. This means taking out all the Headhunter servers at [LOCATION] as well as tracking down [TARGET NAME] to stop them from further disseminating the information.

Your help is much appreciated,
 
Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity

missions.name: CFP_Pyro_Intro_Hauling
missions.title: First Haul in System
missions.description:
Welcome to the system, not sure if you're familiar with our organization but Citizens for Prosperity are a non-profit organization dedicated to bringing security and civilization to unclaimed systems.

If you're looking for work in the system and would like to help achieve our goal, we need a package picked up from [LOCATION] and taken to [DESTINATION].

Once complete, we can offer you a variety of new job opportunities in this system and beyond.

Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity

missions.name: CFP_Pyro_RegionA_Stage1_RegionLink_ToRegionD_Hauling
missions.title: Need a Hauler
missions.description:
Hi, we need to move some cargo across the system and were wondering if you could help. I know this is outside your usual purview, but I'm low on options. This would also be a great way to show your committed to Citizens for Prosperity's greater mission here.

If you head to [LOCATION], there should be some cargo accessible via a freight elevator that we'll need you to take to another freight elevator at [DESTINATION].

Only thing to call out is that your ship must be able to handle [MISSION MAX SCUSIZE] cargo containers. To make your life easier, be sure you have a handheld tractor beam with you. Otherwise, it should be a simple run. 

Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity

missions.name: CFP_DisableCommsTowers_Easy
missions.title: Disable Headhunter Comm Towers
missions.description:
Violence is never our first choice, but sometimes it must be used as a preventative measure.

We’re planning a strike on a Headhunter controlled outpost and need your help.

We need to make sure that if something goes wrong they won’t be able to call for backup and escalate the situation. That’s where you come in. We need you to head over to [LOCATION] and disable the communication towers. There should be a control panel located at the top of each tower that you can use to deactivate them.

If you’re able to do this, Citizens for Prosperity will be able to gain some vital ground in Pyro.

It’s also worth keeping in mind for future contracts that you can choose to take out the comms towers instead of risking a fight with reinforcement dropships.

Stay alert and stay safe.

Thank you,

Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity

missions.name: CFP_DisableCommsTowers_Hard
missions.title: Shutdown Xenothreat Comm Towers
missions.description:
Citizens for Prosperity are eager to help the people of Pyro, and it starts with freeing them from the grasp of XenoThreat.

We’re preparing a team to infiltrate one of their outposts, but we need someone to go in ahead to take out their communication towers first. Once those towers are offline, they won’t be able to call for reinforcements and we can proceed with our plan.

Head to [LOCATION] and find the towers. At the top is a control panel that can be used to disable them.

Also, it’s worth noting that most outposts use a similar system, so you’ll know how to disable the comms towers rather than risk fighting reinforcement dropships when you’re doing other jobs.

Good luck,

Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity

missions.name: CFP_Pyro_RegionA_Rank0_Regional_Handyman
missions.title: Minor Repairs Needed: [LOCATION]
missions.description:
Hi,

One of our outposts at [LOCATION] is in need of some light repairs. The folks onsite have estimated that you’ll need three fuses, a salvaging tool, and enough RMC canisters to fix up to three or so pipes.

If you need more information on maintenance work, see “Cornerstone Developments' Guide to Maintenance” entry in your mobiGlas Journal.

Thanks again for your help,

Lima Endicott

missions.name: CFP_Pyro_RegionA_E_JacksonsSwap_XSOutposts_EliminateSpecific
missions.title: Protection against [TARGET NAME]
missions.description:
Reports indicate that [LOCATION] has come under attack from a group of armed individuals led by a notorious outlaw named [TARGET NAME]. There have been multiple reported deaths and injuries, so Citizens for Prosperity has been looking for qualified combat operatives to provide some support. 

Though we don't advocate conflict resolution through violence, we believe that the group will disperse if [TARGET NAME] is not there to lead them.

Head over as soon as you can. Lives are on the line.

Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity

missions.name: CFP_Pyro_E_DerelictOutpostsCaves_EliminateAll
missions.title: Assistance needed at [LOCATION]
missions.description:
We received a distress call from [LOCATION] saying that they're being robbed by a small group of outlaws. [LOCATION] Though remote, this outpost is a crucial piece of CFP's infrastructure in the area so we need to take it back.

Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity

missions.name: CFP_Pyro_M_XSOutposts_EliminateAll
missions.title: Defend [LOCATION] from Outlaws
missions.description:
We learned that [LOCATION] is under threat of attack by outlaws and has asked for assistance. We need someone to protect them and drive away the outlaws. 

Make sure you stay close after their initial attack. Too often, outlaws win fights just by sending more bodies than anyone can reasonably defend against, so make sure you fight off any reinforcements before leaving the area. 

Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity

missions.name: CFP_Pyro_RegionA_CFPOutpost_Stage1_RegionLink_ToRegionB_EliminateAll
missions.title: Call for Help: [LOCATION]
missions.description:
We've received a distress call from [LOCATION]. A group of unknown assailants have launched an attack. There have been multiple deaths reported and we need to reclaim the outpost.

I know this is far from your current position, but we're desperate to secure the area and get the outpost back and running again.

Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher

missions.name: CFP_Pyro_XSOutpost_HHEliminateAll
missions.title: Reclaim Headhunter Outpost
missions.description:
Citizens for Prosperity is looking for security personnel to take a former CFP outpost that's currently serving as a hideout for Headhunters to launch attacks throughout the system. 

Located near [LOCATION], reclaiming this outpost will allow CFP to provide greater support to local efforts to build stability.

Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity

missions.name: CFP_Pyro_RegionC_XSOutpost_XTEliminateAll
missions.title: Reclaim XenoThreat Outpost
missions.description:
Despite our efforts to promote non-violence, local outlaw groups continue to attack our organization. XenoThreat recently assaulted [LOCATION] and chased out our volunteers that had been working there.

We're looking to enlist combat personnel to retake the outpost. Ideally we could work something out to encourage them to move on, but XenoThreat quickly resorts to violence to solve all their issues so there will undoubtedly be a fight.

Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity

missions.name: CFP_Pyro_RegionC_CFPOutpost_HHEliminateAll
missions.title: Defenders needed against Headhunters
missions.description:
We received an emergency comm from [LOCATION] reporting that they are currently under attack by a group of Headhunters. We know our presence in the system has upset the Headhunters, but it hardly excuses this unprovoked attack.

If available, please gather your gear and head out. Just understand that Headhunters are experienced fighters and will not back down easily.

Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity

missions.name: CFP_Pyro_RegionC_CFPOutpost_XTEliminateAll
missions.title: Protecting outpost from XenoThreat
missions.description:
XenoThreat forces launched an unprovoked attack near [LOCATION]. We're looking for any available combat operators to go and provide support. 

If you haven't dealt with them before, it's important to know that XenoThreat are trained fighters so this will not be an easy fight, but it's a necessary one.

Good luck,

Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity

missions.name: CFP_Pyro_RegionC_CFPOutpost_EliminateAll
missions.title: Attack on CFP outpost
missions.description:
Citizens for Prosperity is looking for any available combat operators to [LOCATION]. A group of outlaws have launched an unprovoked attack and our security personnel are desperately in need of support.

Please dispatch to [LOCATION] with all urgency and good luck.

Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity

missions.name: CFP_Pyro_RegionB_H_CFPOutposts_HH_EliminateAll
missions.title: Headhunter attack on [LOCATION]
missions.description:
A distress call just came in from [LOCATION] claiming that a large Headhunter force has just attacked our outpost there. There have been multiple deaths and injuries from those who managed to flee the scene. We're looking for any available security personnel to head there and retake the outpost.

Witness accounts identified the attackers as elite Headhunter enforcers, so watch yourself out there and bring help if you can. 

Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity

missions.name: CFP_Pyro_RegionB_M_CFPXSOutposts_HH_EliminateAll
missions.title: [LOCATION] needs assistance
missions.description:
Headhunters have launched an unprovoked attack against [LOCATION]. Although we don't support the use of violence, Citizens for Prosperity won't let innocent people die. We need qualified security personnel to retake the outpost.

Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity

missions.name: CFP_Pyro_RegionB_VH_CFPOutposts_XT_EliminateAll
missions.title: Protect [LOCATION] from XenoThreat Incursion
missions.description:
Urgent!

XenoThreat is mobilizing for a massive incursion to wipe [LOCATION] off the map. You’re their only hope of enduring this assault and protecting them from XenoThreat’s cruelty.

I know I’m asking you to put yourself in the line of fire, but this system won’t change unless people like you are brave enough to take on these dangers. No amount of credits could measure up to how much good you’d be doing by stepping in.

If you’re willing and able to take on this mission, make sure to take some allies with you. XenoThreat will certainly send in stronger reinforcements once they realize they’re taking losses.

We believe in you.

Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity

missions.name: CFP_Pyro_RegionB_H_CFPXSOutposts_XT_EliminateAll
missions.title: Protect [LOCATION] from XenoThreat Raid
missions.description:
Urgent!

XenoThreat is targeting [LOCATION] to send a message to other settlers about what happens if they accept our support. 

If you’re able to fend off the attackers, I’m sure they’ll send additional forces, so you’ll need to dig in for multiple assaults. Since XenoThreat has a lot of resources at their disposal, you should think about recruiting others to help you keep everyone safe.

We’re all counting on you.

Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity

missions.name: CFP_Pyro_RegionB_E_ChainElimAll_1Cluster
missions.title: Defend [LOCATION] from Outlaws

Citizens for Prosperity

missions.name: CFP_Pyro_RegionB_M_ChainElimAll_1Cluster_HHAttack
missions.title: Help defend [LOCATION] from Headhunters
missions.description:
We just received a frantic comm from [LOCATION] and are looking for any available combat specialists to help repel a Headhunter attack. There are still hostiles on site and there are reports of several casualties so we need this handled quickly.

I will provide all relevant data upon acceptance. Thank you for your assistance.

Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity

missions.name: CFP_Pyro_RegionB_M_ChainElimAll_1Cluster_XTAttack
missions.title: Protect [LOCATION] from XenoThreat Attack
missions.description:
We’ve learned that XenoThreat is about to launch an attack on [LOCATION]. If they are successful, the number of casualties is expected to be high. I’m hoping that with your aid in defending them, we can make sure that doesn’t happen.
 
We know from past encounters that XenoThreat sends several raiding parties to carry out their attacks, so make sure you don’t leave the outpost until you’ve fought off all the reinforcements. 

Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity

missions.name: CFP_Pyro_RegionB_E_ChainElimAll_1Cluster_ElimSpec
missions.title: Alert: [LOCATION] under attack
missions.description:
We need any available security personnel to report to [LOCATION]. A group of armed individuals have attacked one of our outpost clusters and we're in desperate need of help. Although the group seems to be unaffiliated with any of the known gangs, we've received word that their leader is [TARGET NAME], a local outlaw with a vicious reputation.

Please head out as soon as you can and secure the area by taking out the outlaws and [TARGET NAME].

Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity

missions.name: CFP_Pyro_RegionB_M_ChainElimAll_2Cluster_ElimSpec
missions.title: Outlaw attack at [LOCATION]
missions.description:
Several CFP clusters near [LOCATION] just got hit by a group of outlaws led by [TARGET NAME]. We're looking for any available combat specialists to help retake the outposts.

I can provide the locations upon acceptance but we need to clear out the main outpost and satellite installations from all hostile forces and take out [TARGET NAME] as it's unlikely that they will not cease their hostilities if they escape.

Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity

missions.name: CFP_Pyro_RegionB_M_ChainElimAll_3Cluster_ElimSpec
missions.title: Need multiple CFP outposts retaken
missions.description:
The outlaw presence here has become much bolder of late and a lot of people are getting hurt. We've recently lost several clusters around [LOCATION]. While we don't like to have to resort to violence, the board has acknowledged that these locations are crucial to establishing stability in the system and authorized the use of a security detail to retake them.

We're also aware that the embedded hostiles are being led by [TARGET NAME] who's had a history of attacking CFP interests. The board would like [TARGET NAME] dealt with to prevent future attacks.

Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity

missions.name: CFP_Pyro_RegionB_M_ChainElimAll_1Cluster_ElimSpec_HHAttack
missions.title: Taking back from the Headhunters
missions.description:
We are currently looking for any qualified and available security operatives to head out to [LOCATION] and reclaim a CFP installation that had been taken by Headhunters. 

The group that's currently occupying the outpost is being led by [TARGET NAME], a Headhunter of some note who's had a history of aggression against locals and CFP volunteers.

We need all Headhunters secured and [TARGET NAME] taken out.

Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity

missions.name: CFP_Pyro_RegionB_H_ChainElimAll_2Cluster_ElimSpec_HHAttack
missions.title: Retaking Outposts from Headhunters
missions.description:
Citizens for Prosperity is looking for any available security operatives to retake several former CFP installations near [LOCATION] from Headhunter control. These clusters were violently taken from us by [TARGET NAME] and resulted in the deaths of many volunteers.

Bringing these outposts back under our control will help provide more stability to the system. Reports indicate that [TARGET NAME] tends to hide behind their rank and file, so they will likely appear once you've cleared out most of the hostiles.

XenoThreat are trained and motivated so they will not give up easily.

Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity

missions.name: CFP_Pyro_RegionB_VH_ChainElimAll_3Cluster_ElimSpec_HHAttack
missions.title: Reclaiming Clusters from Headhunters
missions.description:
Citizens for Prosperity's board just authorized funds to hire security personnel to retake several clusters near [LOCATION] that have since fallen into the hands of the Headhunters. While we tried to just accept the loss, it's become apparent that they are crucial to our ongoing operations in the system.

You'll need to clear out each of the locations that will be provided but more importantly, you'll also need to take out [TARGET NAME], who's in charge of the hostiles on site.

These Headhunters are heavily embedded and have a history of violence, so you should prepare accordingly. 

Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity

missions.name: CFP_Pyro_RegionB_H_ChainElimAll_2Cluster_ElimSpec_XTAttack
missions.title: Reclaiming Outposts from XenoThreat
missions.description:
Looking for any available security personnel to reclaim several clusters previously lost to XenoThreat aggressors. Located near [LOCATION], they had been seized in brutal attacks led by [TARGET NAME], a notorious XenoThreat lieutenant.

We're looking to take these clusters back so we can reestablish operations and continue our good work. You'll need to clear all the hostiles still on-site as well as [TARGET NAME].

Just a reminder, that XenoThreat are highly trained and quick to fight, so prepare accordingly.

Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity

missions.name: CFP_Pyro_RegionB_VH_ChainElimAll_3Cluster_ElimSpec_XTAttack
missions.title: Campaign to reclaim XenoThreat outposts
missions.description:
Although Citizens for Prosperity is committed to change through non-violent means, it's become apparent that exceptions might have to be made. CFP safe zones near [LOCATION] were recently and violently taken by XenoThreat forces under the command of [TARGET NAME].

We're looking for any available combat operatives to help take these outposts back. This will undoubtedly be a difficult endeavor as XenoThreat are highly trained and eager to fight, so you should prepare accordingly.

Aside from clearing each cluster of XenoThreat forces, you will need to take out [TARGET NAME], who's loss will certainly make the system safer.

Good luck,

Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity

missions.name: CFP_Pyro_RegionD_CFPOutpost_Stage1_RegionLink_ToRegionA_EliminateAll
missions.title: Call for Help: [LOCATION]
missions.description:
We've received a distress call from [LOCATION]. A group of unknown assailants have launched an attack. There have been multiple deaths reported and we need to reclaim the outpost.

I know this is far from your current position, but we're desperate to secure the area and get the outpost back and running again.

Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity

missions.name: CFP_Pyro_RegionA_H_CFPOutposts_MultiEliminateAllAndBoss
missions.title: [LOCATION] needs help
missions.description:
We just received reports of a massive attack against [LOCATION] by a large group of armed individuals led by [TARGET NAME], a notorious outlaw who has been threatening Citizens for Prosperity personnel for months. Details are still yet to be confirmed but we know there have been multiple casualties.

Citizens for Prosperity is looking for any qualified security personnel to go and retake the outposts from these hostile elements. Our understanding is that [TARGET NAME] tends to hide behind their soldiers, but will emerge if you take enough of the rank-and-file out.

While we don't like to resort to violence, management can see no other way of resolving this situation and continuing our good work in the system.

Good luck,

Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity

missions.name: CFP_Pyro_Intro_EliminateAll
missions.title: Establishing Security
missions.description:
Welcome to the system, not sure if you're familiar with our organization but Citizens for Prosperity are a non-profit organization dedicated to bringing security and civilization to unclaimed systems.

If you're looking for work in the system and would like to help achieve our goal, we are looking for anyone with combat experience to help secure [LOCATION] that has been taken over by a group of outlaws.

We've tried to work with them but have only been met with violence and threats.

Once complete, we can offer you a variety of new job opportunities in this system and beyond.

Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity

missions.name: CFP_Pyro_RegionA_M_KillShip
missions.title: Danger: Contraband Weapons Inbound
missions.description:
This is a general warning. We have learned that the Headhunters are transporting a large amount of weapons into the system with the intent of launching attacks against CFP-owned settlements.

While we believe that change can only come to this system through nonviolence. The presence of these weapons will undoubtedly cause considerably more bloodshed and devastation so we want to remove them from the equation.

Any of our supporters with appropriate combat training are asked to undertake this dangerous assignment out near [LOCATION]. We will compensate you for the tremendous risk you are taking.

Thank you and be safe out there,

Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity

missions.title: Danger: Contraband Weapons Inbound
missions.description:
This is a general warning. We have learned that the Headhunters are transporting a large amount of weapons into the system with the intent of launching attacks against CFP-owned settlements.

While we believe that change can only come to this system through nonviolence. The presence of these weapons will undoubtedly cause considerably more bloodshed and devastation so we want to remove them from the equation.

Thank you and be safe out there,

Lima Endicott

missions.description:

One of our veteran haulers got sick and backed out of a run that we desperately needed. [TARGET NAME] stepped up and offered to do it. I was hesitant to give it to ‘em because it’s riskier than the routes they normally do. Seems like my concern was warranted. Last update we got from ‘em was near [LOCATION], which is XenoThreat territory.

Can’t have this hanging over my head much longer. Any chance you’d be willing to head to their last known location and see if you can find out what happened? It’d mean a lot to me and others. Not only to know the status of [TARGET NAME] but also the cargo, which is really needed at [DESTINATION]. If you find it and complete the delivery, it would be a huge help to the CFP members there.   

Fly safe out there,

Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity

missions.title: Find XenoThreat Captives and Stolen Data
missions.description:
A small group of Citizens for Prosperity members were supposed to be delivering sensitive data back to our headquarters in Stanton, but they never arrived.

Your help is very appreciated,
 
Lima Endicott

missions.name: CFP_Pyro_RegionC_Caves_ChainMissingPersons
missions.title: Missing Volunteers
missions.description:
Two of our volunteers vanished while on a recent foraging expedition. It has been over two standard days since their disappearance, and their families have begun to fear the worst and are willing to offer a reward if someone can help trace their whereabouts.

They were last seen in the vicinity of [LOCATION]. It is possible that they may have been injured and sought shelter in an abandoned building or a cave. The area is full of potential hiding spots, so your search will need to be thorough. 

Thank you for taking this on. 

Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity

missions.name: CFP_Pyro_RegionB_VH_MissingPerson_Theft_XT
missions.title: Find [TARGET NAME] and Missing Supplies
missions.description:
Hey,

Wondering if you can help me. I’ve lost touch with a dedicated CFP volunteer named [TARGET NAME] who was tracking down supplies taken by XenoThreat. Their last comm said they believed our stuff was being held at [LOCATION]. I told them to be careful, but haven’t heard anything since.

Any chance you can head out and try to locate [TARGET NAME]? While there, if you spot the supplies, please bring them to [DESTINATION]. I’ll give you the same warning I gave [TARGET NAME], that spot is a known Xeno stronghold. Better be prepared. Would hate for you to disappear too after visiting that spot. 

Be Safe, 

Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity

missions.name: CFP_Pyro_RegionB_H_MissingPerson_Theft_XTXS
missions.title: Search a XenoThreat Remote Outpost
missions.description:
Hi,

Got a tough assignment here. There’s a small, satellite outpost near [LOCATION] that needs to be investigated. I received intel that it’s housing some of our stolen supplies and sent [TARGET NAME] to retrieve them. Haven’t heard anything from them in a while and am worried they ran into trouble.

XenoThreat controls that location, but I hoped [TARGET NAME] could slip in and out without getting noticed. Seems like that spot might be more heavily guarded than expected. Looking for someone to take a look and see what happened to [TARGET NAME]. Also, if any of our supplies are found there, I need them taken to [DESTINATION]. 

Do you think you can give it a shot? I’m guessing that the Xenos are entrenched there. Prepare accordingly and don’t expect them to make this easy on you.  

Thanks, 

Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity

missions.name: CFP_Pyro_RegionB_H_MissingPerson_Theft_HH
missions.title: Investigate Headhunters Outpost
missions.description:
Hey,

I’ve been tracking Headhunters activity at [LOCATION]. Recently, they stocked it with supplies we believe were stolen from one of our cargo convoys. [TARGET NAME] offered to go get our goods back but hasn’t checked in since. Really need to know what happened to them and if our supplies are there.

Think this is something you could handle? You’ll probably have to deal with Headhunters forces to get to the bottom of this. Also, any goods you grab should go to [DESTINATION] once you’re out of there.

Thanks, 

Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity

missions.title: Find [TARGET NAME]
missions.description:
Last night, some no-name drifters threw down with our enforcers and ran when things got too hot. Didn't find out 'til they were long gone, but they made off with one of our Prospects when they split. Goes by the name of [TARGET NAME].

Stows out.

missions.name: CFP_Pyro_RegionA_XTBase_Rank3_ChainMissingPerson
missions.title: Missing: [TARGET NAME]
missions.description:
An upstanding member of the Citizens for Prosperity community, Doctor [TARGET NAME], was recently abducted by XenoThreat while distributing vital medical supplies to one of our settlements.

The kidnappers were last seen entering their base at [LOCATION], but we are uncertain whether they will remain there for long. XenoThreat maintains multiple outposts throughout this system and has been known to swap locations at a moment's notice. 

Considering the danger and the distance you may have to travel, CFP is prepared to offer a substantial reward for determining what happened to Dr. [TARGET NAME].

Lima Endicott

missions.title: Patrol Travel Lanes
missions.description:
We need someone with combat experience to patrol a travel lane for us. Over the years, we’ve found that it's good to get out there and make ourselves visible. Sometimes a pilot like yourself traveling through an area is enough to deter any potential outlaws. But in case you run into any that are feeling a bit more ambitious, a ship ready for combat is recommended.

Once you’ve accepted this contract, make your way to the location marker on your HUD. After you’ve scanned all the waypoints and ensured that the route is secure, the main contractor will get a bonus of [SCRIP AMOUNT] MG Scrip.


Lima Endicott

Outlaws have been increasing their activity along one of the more popular routes in the system and we’re hoping to provide a deterrent before the problem gets out of hand. As such, we’d like you to head out there in a combat-ready ship and deal with any hostiles you might encounter.

Once you’ve accepted this contract, make your way to the location marker on your HUD and scan the waypoints along the route. After all of them have been secured, the main contractor will get a bonus of [SCRIP AMOUNT] MG Scrip.


Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity

missions.name: CFP_Pyro_VeryEasy_RecoverCargo
missions.title: Intercepted Supply Run
missions.description:
Life is tough on the frontier, and every delivery to our settlers is important. We really can't afford to lose any more this year.

One of our key suppliers has been hit by a group of outlaws over at [LOCATION] and gone silent on us. I fear the worst, but if we can still recover the supplies they were transporting, it could make a huge difference.

Chances are the outlaws who attacked them are still lurking around there so be on your guard. Once you've dealt with them, grab the cargo and take it to the freight elevator at [DESTINATION]. Make sure you're flying a ship that can carry [MISSION MAX SCUSIZE] cargo containers and bring a heavy-duty tractor beam too.

Fly safe out there,

Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity

Be safe out there,

missions.name: CFP_Pyro_Hard_RecoverCargo
missions.title: Crucial Supplies Need Retrieving
missions.description:
We were in the process of delivering an urgent shipment to the folks over at [DESTINATION] when our pilot ran into a group of outlaws. They tried to run, but it was already too late.

There is silver lining though. The trackers are showing the cargo is still intact, located at [LOCATION]. There's a good chance the outlaws are guarding it while they locate a ship big enough to transport everything. While I don't want to risk losing another pilot, the need of the cargo aboard is desperate enough that it justifies the decision to send someone to recover it.

This won't be easy, these outlaws showed our pilot no mercy. You'll need to take them out first before getting the cargo back. Bring a ship that can store [MISSION MAX SCUSIZE] cargo containers and a heavy-duty tractor beam for the moving. Deliver it to the freight elevator at [DESTINATION]  and let's make this right.

Fly safe,

Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher

missions.description:
More and more CFP ships are being targeted lately, and despite our best efforts to keep our trading routes quiet, we're still losing haulers to outlaw attacks.

Our pilot over at [LOCATION] is the latest casualty. It pains me to think about how much we've lost, but as long as there are people who need our help, we have to keep on fighting.

If you have a ship that can carry [MISSION MAX SCUSIZE] cargo containers and a heavy-duty tractor beam, we need you to head to the above location and recover that cargo.

This won't be easy, the pilot was one of our best and wouldn't go down without a fight. Let's not underestimate these outlaws, bring a trustworthy crew and watch each other's backs.

Once you've got the cargo, deliver it to the freight elevator at [DESTINATION] and I'll get it processed.

Good luck and take care,

missions.name: CFP_Pyro_Super_RecoverCargo
missions.title: Special Recovery Operation
missions.description:
I wouldn't normally ask someone to do something so risky, but these are exceptional circumstances.

Our pilot was transporting some vital cargo when they were targeted by a group of outlaws. Under no circumstances can we allow them to get their hands on the cargo.

With the size of the hostile force who attacked, you won't be able to do this on your own, you'll need to bring a skilled crew with you to  [LOCATION] in order to  take out these outlaws and get the cargo back. Make sure at least one of you has a ship that can store [MISSION MAX SCUSIZE] cargo containers and a heavy-duty tractor beam.

If by some miracle you can get that cargo back, take it to the freight elevator located at [DESTINATION].

It's a lot to ask, but if you can pull this off you'll have my and the whole organizations appreciation.

Best of luck,

Lima Endicott

missions.name: CFP_Pyro_RegionA_Lagrange_LRT_RetrieveCargo
missions.title: Retrieve Supplies
missions.description:
Hi,

It appears an electrical issue caused us to lose track of a [SHIP] carrying medical supplies. Thankfully, I received word that the ship was found at [LOCATION]. We really need someone to get out there and recover the supplies onboard before someone else does. Those provisions are desperately needed at [DESTINATION]. Any chance you could grab them and complete the delivery? 

Makes me nervous seeing that the ship is at a lagrange point. Lots of folks scour them for stuff like this. Would be smart to come prepared to defend yourself if someone else comes looking to steal it.

Also, to make your life easier, I'd make sure you have a handheld tractor beam with you.    

Thanks,

Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity

This shouldn't be a tough one. You might run into a ship or two and maybe a few turrets, but you've been authorized to use lethal force. All we need for you to do is get in there, get the fuel tanks, and get out.

Good luck,

Kevin Walton

missions.name: Hockrow_FacilityDelve_P1M1
missions.title: Jorrit Dossier: Onyx Personnel Files
missions.description:
Hockrow Agency 
Case File #JD10285
Lead Investigator: Arken Mallor

Case Summary: 
A client has requested that Hockrow compile a complete dossier on infamous scientist Dr. Logan Jorrit. Believed responsible for the incidents at Associated Science & Development’s Lazarus site, the client is eager to get a broader view of Dr. Logan and his research.

Contract Investigator Actions: 
Gain access to ASD’s shuttered Onyx Facility where Dr. Jorrit was formerly the Lead Scientist.  Once there, locate and access the research lab’s personnel files so that we can get an overview of what was going on there.

Additional Notes:
The QT beacon to the site was deactivated when the facility went dark so you'll have to fly the last leg manually.

While ASD has formally closed the facility, caution is still advised. Not only may the labs themselves be hazardous, but the surrounding area shows signs of recent visitors. Scavengers or squatters may be on site.

I've also managed to wrangle an employee ID code for you so as long as you're on the job, you'll be able to access the computers there. 

Additionally, Onyx Facility only has large hangars available, so plan your travel appropriately.

missions.name: Hockrow_FacilityDelve_P1M2
missions.title: Jorrit Dossier: Access Engineering Files
missions.description:
Hockrow Agency 
Case File #JD10285
Lead Investigator: Arken Mallor

Case Update: 
From the personnel files recovered at the Onyx Facility, we have now learned that Dr. Jorrit has recently visited the site and accessed files while there. The next step will be to follow this lead and try to learn exactly what Dr. Jorrit was doing in his old lab.

Contract Investigator Actions:
Explore the Engineering wing and access Dr. Jorrit’s recent files.

Additional Notes:
I've found a work around for the QT issue so you'll be able to travel directly to the site from now on.

Be wary of possible hostile forces on site. 

Travel to Onyx in a vehicle that can be stored in a large hangar.

missions.name: Hockrow_FacilityDelve_P1M3
missions.title: Jorrit Dossier: Access Research Files
missions.description:
Hockrow Agency 
Case File #JD10285
Lead Investigator: Arken Mallor

Case Update:
The files you found in Engineering confirm that Dr. Jorrit is actively pursuing something at the site, but it is still unclear what the doctor is up to. I’m hoping that if you can find the data he was accessing in Research it will provide further clarity.


Contract Investigator Actions:
Explore the Research wing to locate and access Dr. Jorrit’s recent files .

Additional Notes:
Be wary of possible hostile forces on site. 

Travel to Onyx in a vehicle that can be stored in a large hangar.

missions.name: Pacheco_HijackedShip_Caterpillar
missions.title: [CONTRACTOR]
missions.description:
Here’s the deal - A couple of long timers got snagged pulling a job for me and I want you to spring them. 

A friendly mechanic has arranged for their prison transport to run into some trouble en route, venting the front door and bringing the ship to a halt. You’re gonna go, dispatch any security escorting the transport, find the prisoner manifest aboard, and use it to locate my crew’s cryopods.

The popsicles I’m after are [NAME SAVE2], [NAME KILL1], [NAME SAVE3], and [NAME SAVE1]. All have been loyal and deserve better than rotting in jail.

At least I think they've been loyal... I'm still wondering how they got pinched in the first place. I can't shake the feeling that one of them may have been doubling dealing. Tell you what, if you find any proof that one of my crew has been working with the Advocacy, liquidate their cryopod and I’ll see you get a bonus. 

Once you've activated the right pods and my people are starting to thaw, get the hell out of there and let the retrieval team handle the rest. This last bit is important. See, once they’re defrosted, they're gonna be sent off to retirement. No sense in them knowing any more about my business than they already do, i.e. I don’t want these lunks seeing your face or even knowing you exist. 

Once you’re back on your way, I’ll send you a hefty pile of well deserved creds.

Now just in case you’re getting any ideas along the lines of “Why don’t I just free everyone?” or “Wouldn’t it be easier to shut them all up permanently?” Forget it. The politics of this whole thing is more complicated than you need to know. Just trust me when I say that if any extra prisoners get freed or die without me ordering it, you’ll be the one who pays. Want all your money? Do what you’re told and that’s it. 

-Twitch

Do what you want with the gun-toting goons guarding the workers, but remember that they aren’t the priority.

missions.name: Ruto_Unlawful_EliminateAll_NoNonHostiles
missions.title: live and let an independent contractor deal out revenge
missions.description: Everybody holds grudges, right? I mean, when you get popped pulling a crime, I get that you’re a little sour, but that’s pretty much the game, right?

missions.name: Ruto_Unlawful_EliminateAll_EliminateCompetition_NoNonHostiles
missions.title: good help’s hard to find
missions.description:
I know someone who’s looking to start up a new business, but they’re having a hard time hiring the skilled workers they need.

Now the thing is, they found the perfect crew over at [LOCATION], but the people they work for won’t let them go. Even hired extra armed guards to make sure of it.

What I want you to do, is go there and kill all the guards while making sure all the workers remain unharmed.

missions.name: Ruto_StantonStar_Illegal_ClearCrimestat_Standard
missions.title: let's help each other
missions.description:
Hey there. I heard you ended up in Klescher which is a real drag. But it might actually be a lucky day for both of us.

Long story short, I had somebody sneaking a datachip out of the prison, but they never got back to me. I know for a fact they haven’t left the facility, so I think something might have happened to them. While tragic, business must carry on. If you can get the chip and finish the job, I can clear your crimestat for you. What do you say?

Of course, I don't know exactly how far they got, but I can tell you that the prison's got a whole network of hidden tunnels my guy was planning on using to make his escape. My guess is his corpse is rotting away somewhere there.

Once you find the body, I’m hoping the chip will still be on him. When you’ve got it, finish escaping and get the data to me. There’s a spot nearby you can upload the chip’s contents. 

One warning though, you might want to watch out for Hurston Security. They've been a hassle lately, so I wouldn't be surprised if you ran into them.

When I've got the data I’ll wipe your crimestat and then, voila, you’ll be free and clear. What you do after that is entirely up to you.

missions.name: Ruto_StantonStar_Illegal_ClearCrimestat_Intro
missions.title: need an out?
missions.description:
Hi there. We haven’t had a chance to work together yet but I’m in a bit of a bind here and I could use another body. Not for nothing, of course. I’m all for a good quid pro quo.

One of my associates who was serving some time in Klescher was supposed to bring me a datachip, but then they went quiet. Now I’m assuming they’re dead, but here’s the deal: if you finish his job, I wipe your crimestat. Not bad, right?

Your predecessor was apparently planning on using some old tunnels to make his escape. He made it sound like they weren't exactly the easiest thing to access, but I trust you can figure it out. I'm guessing you'll find his body somewhere in there and if we’re lucky, he'll still have the chip on him.

Once you get it, finish getting out however you can. Then get the data to me. There’s a spot nearby you can upload the chip’s contents. You might want to watch out for Hurston Security, though. They've been a hassle lately, so I wouldn't be surprised if you ran into them. After I get the data and validate it, I’ll wipe your crimestat. 

Then you can go and enjoy your newfound freedom. If you do this right, maybe I’ll have more lucrative work for you down the line.
