Vanduul have strange ways. I never talk to them, old souli used to, but not Wikelo. Anyway, though not friendly, they make interesting thing. If you like, Wikelo can make you look more like.

Bring things. Will do.

Bye.

missions.name: TheCollector_BigBooma
missions.title: Curious Weapon
missions.description:
Wikelo find very strange but functional weapon while wandering through your systems. It very simple but very effective. If you bring me things, I show you what I do to it.

Very fun.

missions.name: TheCollector_NonePistol
missions.title: Hot Shot
missions.description:
You need a good weapon, yes? Have one for you. Small but powerful. Like an extra spicy balalu pepper. Wikelo make this pistol look extra spicy too. You bring things I need and I do a trade.

Bye.

missions.name: TheCollector_GeminiShotgun
missions.title: Red Fight Shotgun
missions.description: Shooting can be messy. Red Human Blood everywhere. Not a problem with this shotgun. Splashes blends right in! I give it to you if you give me everything I want on list. Good trade.

missions.name: TheCollector_RedHunterArmour
missions.title: Red Fight Armor
missions.description: Wikelo hear that Humans think red is the color of passion and anger. This armor good for both. You give me items on list and this red armor is yours.

missions.name: TheCollector_vglFlightsuit
missions.title: Suit Up Take Off
missions.description: Ships have big windows. Everyone can see you flying. You should look the best. Wikelo has very good flight suit for you. Do trade, bring me what I need and Wikelo give suit. Give blueprint as well if you do not have.

missions.name: TheCollector_NoneAssultRifle
missions.title: Your Best Shot
missions.description: This rifle is very good at shooting, but could have nicer design. Wikelo fix. Looks very nice now. Give to you for trade. Bring me things, I give you rifle. Even give you blueprint if you need.

missions.name: TheCollector_Intro
missions.title: Wikelo Arrive to System
missions.description:
Hello, I am Wikelo. Recent addition to your system and very excited to be here. Spent many time here in UEE and happy to spent more.

Have place where I make things from other things.

Need person to bring me useful things to finish project I work on. You have list. Get, please. I am at [DESTINATION].

Will give you item for your help.

Also, when done, if you want to do more. Have many things can make in my humble shop. Come, look at pretty poster and then decide what you want me to make.

Bye.

missions.name: TheCollector_FoodOrder
missions.title: Very Hungry
missions.description:
You humans keep Wikelo very busy. Work more than when I at old souli. But Wikelo very hungry now and can't get food.

Please help. Bring food and drink to Wikelo Emporium at [DESTINATION].

Very appreciate your help. Will give thing in return.

Bye.

missions.name: TheCollector_Favours_IrradiatedPearls
missions.title: Trade Worm Parts for Favors?
missions.description:
Have new way to get favors from Wikelo. Hear much about worm things in radiation storms. Made up of many interesting parts that Wikelo find use for. 

If you bring parts to [DESTINATION], will trade for favor.

Bye.

itemRewards.name: carryable_1h_cy_banu_favour_wikelo

missions.name: TheCollector_Favours_MercScrip
missions.title: Trade Merc Scrip for Favors?
missions.description:
Wikelo has another way to get favors if you interested. 

Your Mercenary souli has scrip metal, used like favors, but made of very interesting metal that Wikelo need for new project.

If you bring scrips to [DESTINATION], will trade for favor.

Bye.

itemRewards.name: carryable_1h_cy_banu_favour_wikelo

missions.name: TheCollector_Favours_CouncilScrip
missions.title: Trade Council Scrip for Favors?
missions.description:
If you want other way to get favors from Wikelo, have thing for you. Wikelo have need for scrip given out by Council group. Wikelo not part of thief souli, but has business from time to time.

If you bring scrips to [DESTINATION], will trade for favor.

Bye.

itemRewards.name: carryable_1h_cy_banu_favour_wikelo

missions.name: TheCollector_Favours_Caranite
missions.title: Turn Things to Favor
missions.description:
Maybe Wikelo not have something you want made (that strange, but okay). Old souli would give out favors, very good way to prove that you do work for me. Collect enough and trade when I have something you want.

Bring things to [DESTINATION] and will trade for favor.

Bye.

itemRewards.name: carryable_1h_cy_banu_favour_wikelo

missions.name: TheCollector_Favours_PolarisParts
missions.title: Want Polaris? Need something special.
missions.description:
Wikelo need large amounts of quantainium and is willing to give you nice Polaris in exchange but also know many humans not have much space, so you trade as you go. Wikelo will you Polaris bits if you want trade quantainium. Work like favors. Help Wikelo remember how much you give. 

Bring quantainium to [DESTINATION] and will trade for bits.

Bye.

itemRewards.name: carryable_1h_cy_banu_favour_wikelo_special

missions.name: TheCollector_Vehicle_Small_Fortune
missions.title: Fortune ship for you
missions.description: Hello, practicing on making ship fly better. Xi'an help human make ship. Fly good. Salvage good. But Wikelo can make better if you want. Bring things and will do. Bye.

itemRewards.name: MISC Fortune Wikelo Special

missions.name: TheCollector_Vehicle_Ground_Nox
missions.title: Noxy Mod
missions.description: Wikelo know many Xi'an. Talk slow but very interesting if you have patience. This is very fast little thing to get you across planet. Wikelo made a few tweaks to make it zippier. If you want, Wikelo will make for you. Bye.

itemRewards.name: Aopoa Nox Wikelo Special

missions.name: TheCollector_Vehicle_Small_Intrepid
missions.title: Upgrade Intrepid
missions.description: If you are looking for Intrepid ship that more intrepid. Wikelo can help. Bring things and you will get special touches on ship by Wikelo and pretty new coat to it. Bye.

itemRewards.name: Crusader Intrepid Wikelo Work Special

missions.name: TheCollector_Vehicle_Ground_Pulse
missions.title: Pulse Plus
missions.description: Wikelo really like this little Human ship. Pulse feel very fast. Can have many configuration to make Pulse go faster. If you want, can give you configurated Pulse that I like. Have list of what I want for job. Bye.

itemRewards.name: Mirai Pulse Wikelo Special

missions.name: TheCollector_Vehicle_Ground_Ursa_Medical
missions.title: Make a Ursa Mod
missions.description: Wikelo branching into ships too. Took a look at Ursa and improved. Bring parts for me and I will make for you. Explore planet better. Go do.

itemRewards.name: RSI Ursa Medivac Wikelo Special

missions.name: TheCollector_Vehicle_Medium_GuardianQI
missions.title: Guardian take down ship
missions.description: Insect ship again. This one help take down other ship but if you want it to take down better. Can make. See list and tell Wikelo. Bye.

itemRewards.name: Mirai Guardian QI Wikelo Special

missions.name: TheCollector_Vehicle_Medium_Firebird
missions.title: Firebird Mod
missions.description: Been digging into Aegis Sabre ship. Firebird is very bomb-y. Good build but could make some fun change to it. If you want, I can do. Have a look and tell me. Bye.

itemRewards.name: Aegis Sabre Firebird Wikelo War Special

missions.name: TheCollector_Vehicle_Medium_Scorpius
missions.title: Build a Mod Scorpius
missions.description: Don't know what the name mean, but ship is very fast, very good in fight. With tweak, can better. You see list of what Wikelo need, go get and I make. Bye.

itemRewards.name: RSI Scorpius Wikelo Sneak Special

missions.name: TheCollector_Vehicle_Medium_F7_MK2
missions.title: Wikelo Navy F7
missions.description: Know how much you Humans like Navy so Wikelo have one now. If you want Wikelo version of F7 mk2, bring me things and you are in. Very funny. Bye.

itemRewards.name: Anvil F7 Hornet Mk Wikelo

missions.name: TheCollector_Vehicle_Medium_ZeusES
missions.title: Zeus Special
missions.description: Wikelo can make new version of Zeus ship. I know it important ship to Human. Not sure why, but yes, very useful ship. Anyway, can upgrade and make a little prettier. What I need listed, if you want, bring. Bye.

itemRewards.name: RSI Zeus Mk II ES Wikelo Work Special

missions.name: TheCollector_Vehicle_Medium_ZeusCL
missions.title: Zeus Cargo Special
missions.description: Wikelo can make new version of cargo Zeus ship. If you want, bring what needed, then you can have ship. Fair. Bye.

itemRewards.name: RSI Zeus Mk II CL

missions.name: TheCollector_Vehicle_Medium_Peregrine
missions.title: Peregrine Wikelo Mod
missions.description: Wikelo not want to race but can still make fast ship faster. If you want, bring me things, and go faster.

itemRewards.name: Aegis Sabre Peregrine Wikelo Speedy Special

missions.name: TheCollector_Vehicle_Medium_Spirit_C1
missions.title: Spirit Cargo mod
missions.description: Wikelo love useful cargo ship. Spirit is very useful. If you want one, can make for you. Just bring me things and I will do. Bye.

itemRewards.name: Crusader C1 Spirit

missions.name: TheCollector_Vehicle_Large_F8C_Milt
missions.title: F8 War Mod
missions.description: Can make you custom of F8 that take good fighting ship and make a better fighting ship. Bring things and I will make. Bye.

itemRewards.name: Anvil F8C Lightning Wikelo War Special

missions.name: TheCollector_Vehicle_Large_F8C_Stealth
missions.title: Sneaky Stabber
missions.description: Have the pieces to build useful ship for people who like to sneak then fight. Take F8C ship and make even better. Have put what Wikelo will need to build for you. Now you decide. Bye.

itemRewards.name: Anvil F8C Lightning Wikelo Sneak Special

missions.name: TheCollector_Vehicle_Large_Starlancer_max
missions.title: More than a Max
missions.description: If you want to move many things. Hercules ship, very good for that. Wikelo even know souli back in Protectorate that started to use. Very big. Wikelo can give you similar version if you get what Wikelo need. Look at list and tell me.

itemRewards.name: MISC Starlancer MAX Wikelo Work Special

missions.name: TheCollector_Vehicle_Large_Connie_Tau
missions.title: Want Taurus ship
missions.description: Wikelo came across plans to build Constellation Taurus ship. Nice ship, but Wikelo make a little better. Prettier too. If you want, bring stuff.

itemRewards.name: RSI Constellation Taurus Wikelo War Special

missions.name: TheCollector_Vehicle_Ground_ATLS_IKTI
missions.title: Make ATLS shoot
missions.description:
Hello. Know you human like strange metal suit. How about metal suit with ikti? Sorry, ikti is Banu word, you call it 'gun.' 

If want, bring things I say and I will make for you. Gun will shoot. Cause many damage.

Bye.

itemRewards.name: argo_atls_ikti

missions.name: TheCollector_Vehicle_Ground_ATLS_IKTI_GEO
missions.title: Make jumpy ATLS shoot
missions.description:
Find very fun piece to add to big human suit that let you jump very high. Now you shoot and jump. Exciting.

If you want, bring me these to [DESTINATION]. Will make.

Wikelo

itemRewards.name: argo_atls_geo_ikti

missions.name: TheCollector_Vehicle_Polaris
missions.title: Now make Polaris. Short Time Deal.
missions.description:
Wikelo recently get many blueprints in trade with human who not very smart. Now can make very big ship. 

Not cheap and need many pieces but will make. If you want, go quick, this cost much to Wikelo so won't be able to do for long but I like new Human system so I want to thank you all for welcome.

Bring to [DESTINATION] if want.

Bye.

itemRewards.name: RSI Polaris

missions.name: TheColllector_Vehicle_Ground_ATLS_RedNBlue
missions.title: ATLS Cool Metal Color
missions.description: Wikelo give deep red and green colors to make ATLS legs look like they cooling from heat. Very pretty.

itemRewards.name: argo_atls_geo_collector_grad03

missions.name: TheColllector_Vehicle_Ground_ATLS_WhiteNGreen
missions.title: ATLS Snowland Color
missions.description: Wikelo travel to one Human planet and find very cold, but very pretty. This remind of that.

itemRewards.name: argo_atls_geo_collector_grad01

missions.name: TheColllector_Vehicle_Ground_ATLS_OrangeNGrey
missions.title: ATLS Orange Line
missions.description: Many Human work place have orange color there. Must mean work to you. This suit does work. Make sense.

itemRewards.name: argo_atls_geo_collector_grad02

missions.name: TheCollector_Vehicle_Mediumpin_Medic
missions.title: What is Terrapin?
missions.description:
Wikelo not know this Human word but ship is very useful when things go danger. If you want, can give new version of it. Maybe more useful?

You fly and tell. Bye.

itemRewards.name: Anvil Terrapin Medic Wikelo Savior Special

missions.name: TheCollector_Vehicle_Small_Drake_Golem
missions.title: Golem Rocks
missions.description:
Universe need resources so Wikelo always respect people who dig. Good profession. If you starting and want boost to Golem ship. I can do. 

Bring. 

I make.

itemRewards.name: Drake Golem Wikelo Work Special

missions.name: TheCollector_Vehicle_Large_Starlancer_TAC
missions.title: New Move Big Starlancer Ship
missions.description: If you like big space to move things, Wikelo can do useful and wonder things to MISC ship for you. Bring me pieces and I will give you version even better than what Xi'an can do.

itemRewards.name: MISC Starlancer TAC Wikelo War Special

missions.name: TheCollector_Vehicle_Large_A2
missions.title: Starlifter A2 War Mod
missions.description: Bring Wikelo the things and I make you A2 Starlifter that fights better. Does war so good make you call it A1! Bye.

itemRewards.name: Crusader A2 Hercules Starlifter Wikelo War Special

missions.name: TheCollector_Vehicle_Medium_Starfighter_Ion
missions.title: Sneaky Starfighter Ion
missions.description: Starfighter Ion good ship, but it could be more sneak, yes? Surprise your not friends when you shoot them. I help with this for you. I need the right items and then I can give to you. Bring to me. Bye.

itemRewards.name: Crusader Ares Star Fighter Ion Wikelo Sneak Special

missions.name: TheCollector_Vehicle_Medium_Starfighter_Inferno
missions.title: Starfighter Inferno Special
missions.description: Starfighter Inferno good ship, but what if you want it to be better ship at fighting? Wikelo knows just what to do. You bring me the items and I make it for you. Bye.

itemRewards.name: Crusader Ares Star Fighter Inferno Wikelo War Special

missions.name: TheCollector_Vehicle_Large_Prowler_Utility
missions.title: Prowler More Utility
missions.description: Wikelo work hard. You work hard. Prowler Utility work hard. But you bring me right items, I make it work more hard, then you work less hard. Bye.

itemRewards.name: Esperia Prowler Utility Wikelo Work Special

missions.name: TheCollector_Vehicle_Medium_Guardian
missions.title: Guardian Fight Mod
missions.description: This ship look like insect in the Protectorate. Fun look. Painful sting. Wikelo can make custom version for you if you want. Make enemies sting. Bye.

itemRewards.name: Mirai Guardian Wikelo War Special

missions.name: TheCollector_Vehicle_Medium_GuardianMX
missions.title: Guardian WiK-X
missions.description:
You Humans enjoy strange letter combinations. It very funny. Guardian ship very useful but if you want even more useful, bring me things. I give you better ship. Look better. Act better.

Thank you. Bye.

itemRewards.name: Mirai Guardian MX Wikelo War Special

missions.name: TheCollector_Vehicle_Small_RSI_Meteor
missions.title: RSI Meteor Mod
missions.description:
Meteor big. It heavy. Have many guns. But Wikelo figure out way to make even better. You have things I will take to do.

That is all.

itemRewards.name: RSI Meteor Wikelo Sneak Special

missions.name: TheCollector_Vehicle_Small_MISC_Prospector
missions.title: Prospects Look Good
missions.description: Wikelo loves rocks. Wants to help you get more better rocks. Made this Prospector more better for that tough job. Trade items and you can have.

itemRewards.name: MISC Prospector Wikelo Work Special

missions.name: TheCollector_Vehicle_Small_ARGO_Raft
missions.title: Ready for RAFT?
missions.description: RAFT is very useful. Wikelo take it and make it very very useful. Do work and make you happy. You want? Bring items to Wikelo for trade.

itemRewards.name: Argo RAFT Wikelo Work Special

missions.name: TheCollector_Vehicle_Large_Anvil_Asgard
missions.title: Asgard Fight Mod
missions.description: Wikelo mod Asgard and so that it fights more. You in a fight, this mod is what you want. Plus, good deal on the trade. Just bring items here and I give you the ship.

itemRewards.name: Anvil Asgard Wikelo War Special

missions.name: TheCollector_Vehicle_Small_Kruger_Wolf
missions.title: Where Wolf? Here Wolf
missions.description: If you want to be quiet and surprise people, this is the Wolf you want. Wikelo mod it to be extra stealth. Trade you for it when you bring me the items I want.

itemRewards.name: Kruger L-21 Wolf Wikelo Sneak Special

missions.name: TheCollector_Vehicle_Small_Kruger_Wolf_Unique
missions.title: Most Special Wolf
missions.description: You have been good trade partner for Wikelo. Offer you this very special Wolf mod. Make trade even better - Bring me what I want and I give you the special Wolf AND Antium Armor AND a VOLT LMG. Very good deal for my very good customer.

missions.name: TheCollector_Vehicle_Super_Idris
missions.title: Special Idris For Killing
missions.description: Since Wikelo has done good business with you, make you this very special trade. Idris is a powerful ship perfect for big important person like you. Wikelo has even done mod to make it more dangerous! Bring me a few items and the ship is yours.

itemRewards.name: Aegis Idris-P Wikelo War Special

missions.name: TheCollector_Vehicle_Apollo_Triage
missions.title: Red Fight Apollo
missions.description: Apollo very good ship. Would be much better if ship was red. Wikelo make all things possible. You trade for what I want and we have a deal.

itemRewards.name: RSI Apollo Triage

missions.name: TheCollector_Vehicle_L22_Wolf
missions.title: Extra Special Wolf
missions.description: Wikelo very excited. Have idea for new material. But making it is most tricky. Very complicated. Need help fabricating a test sample. I give you blueprint, you make, bring to me, and I will trade. Give you extra special L-22 Wolf. Very powerful, very wolf.

itemRewards.name: Kruger L-22 Alpha Wolf Wikelo War Special

missions.title: DEAD SAINTS - Trial Cargo Haul
missions.description:
Call me Twitch. I run the Dead Saints. 

I doubt this is the first time you've heard of us, but in case you haven't, we do a lot of things, but one of them is transporting goods that need discreet handling. 

I got your info from one of my contacts. They say you've got the stuff we like in a hauler, which works for me, because we're looking for one. 

Here's my proposal – we're offering creds to the pilot that can transport some special cargo for us. Your ship’s hold will need room for [MISSION MAX SCUSIZE] cargo containers, and you'll need a handheld tractor beam for loading and unloading. All you have to do is get everything from [LOCATION] to [DESTINATION] without getting security involved. 
 
If you can pull the job off, the Saints will have more contracts for you down the line. 

-Twitch

missions.title: DEAD SAINTS -- [REPUTATION RANK] Rank, [CARGO GRADE TOKEN] Scale Cargo Run
missions.description:
Got an interesting one. Some folks who were suckered into life/labor contracts with Hurston Dynamics want to get as far from Lorville as they possibly can. They struck a deal with a people mover and got themselves put on ice. Now they just need someone to pick them up and give them a ride. 

If you're up for some popsicle smuggling, you'll find [TOTAL] cryopods at [LOCATION] that need to go to [DESTINATION]. Make sure you have space in your cargo hold for size [MISSION MAX SCUSIZE] containers. If you use a handheld tractor beam, you should be able to get everyone loaded up before Hurston security catches on. 

HD isn't too keen on anyone slipping out of their contracts, so watch your back. They shoot to kill. 

If you can pull this off, there's a nice paycheck in it for you.

-Twitch

missions.name: DeadSaints_Nyx_VeryEasy_RecoverCargo
missions.title: Finishing The Job
missions.description:
One of my haulers has run into some trouble over at [LOCATION] and was forced to ditch their ship. I need someone to go there with a heavy-duty tractor beam to grab the cargo and finish the job.

They were carrying a decent supply of gear for me, and the last thing I need is for some do-gooder to come across it and trace it back to us.

If you do run into anybody, no need to be friendly. Just shoot the asshole and get my gear. Understood?

Take it to the freight elevator over at [DESTINATION] and I’ll make sure you get a cut of the sale.

-Twitch

shipPool: Drake Cutlass 2949 Best In Show Edition

missions.name: DeadSaints_Nyx_Easy_RecoverCargo
missions.title: Cleaning Up Someone Else’s Mess
missions.description:
You know when you ask someone a question and you have a feeling they’re lying, but you choose to give them the benefit of the doubt? Yeah. That’s what I’m dealing with right now.

Two “expert” haulers I hired to transport some gear for me ran into some trouble and ended up ditching my goods over at [LOCATION]. Needless to say, I’ve ordered a hit on them, but what I need from you is to go recover that cargo. The tracker says the cargo’s still on the ship, so you’ll just need a a heavy-duty tractor beam and your own ship to recover it.

You might run into a couple of scavengers lurking around there, but I doubt you’ll have any trouble with them.

When you’re done, take the stuff to [DESTINATION] and I’ll sort you out with a reward.

-Twitch

Expect the bastards who took out my pilot to still be around, so bring backup. Get the cargo and get out, don’t need to risk anymore good haulers on this mess.

Get the goods to the freight elevator to [DESTINATION] and I’ll send your payment.

-Twitch

missions.title: Lost But Not Gone
missions.description:
A rival crew was able to get their hands on our delivery routes and now they have one of my cargo ships pinned down at [LOCATION].

Now the ship’s sitting there being guarded by a full crew of these assholes. They must be waiting for someone to show up with a transport ship, but you’re going to get there first.

Head there with a crew of your own and a heavy-duty tractor beam to take the goods away. Make sure they’re the best people you got. It’d be a mistake to underestimate these bastards.

Ghost them and bring my cargo back to the freight elevator at [DESTINATION] and I’ll make sure you’re seriously comp’d for this.

-Twitch

Got ourselves in a real mess here. A Headhunters ship on an important mission got attacked near [LOCATION]. Can’t get too into the specifics but it’s absolutely vital that they survive. The People’s Alliance know this too because they’re throwing everything they can at ‘em.

Not gonna pull any punches. This is a serious-ass situation that many wouldn’t survive. If you do, I’ll sing your praises and make sure you’re paid well.   

-Stows

missions.name: Headhunters_BombingRun_Stanton_VE
missions.title: Ground The Upstarts
missions.description:
Headhunters didn't get to be what it is today by playing nice. We've tracked down the hideout of a bunch of scraggy upstarts that have been making inroads into our territory. Need you to send a message.

Head to [LOCATION] and blow the crap out of their fuel tanks. They'll think twice about muscling in on our operations when their ships are grounded.

-Stows out

missions.name: Headhunters_BombingRun_Stanton_E
missions.title: No Fly Zone
missions.description:
Some competition has taken root at [LOCATION] and they've really been gumming up the works for our operations in the area.

Now part of me sees some potential in the upstarts so I'm hoping to bring them into fold, but at the same time, I can't really afford to have them flying around causing trouble.

Instead, I want you to go and blow up their fuel tanks. That should keep them grounded long enough for me to talk some sense into their thick heads.

-Stows out

missions.name: Headhunters_BombingRun_Stanton_M
missions.title: Stopping the Competition
missions.description: Stopping the Competition

missions.name: Headhunters_BombingRun_Stanton_H
missions.title: Wasting Their Stockpile
missions.description:
Look, Headhunters don't waste time on petty revenge, but I'm not about to let this nonsense fly either.

Some asshole took out a bunch of my crew and has been bragging all over about it. I've also heard that this nullbrain is stockpiling quantum fuel over at [LOCATION]. I'd like to see how they deal with some real heat when you fly over there and burn everything they've built to the ground. Oh, and with the amount of firepower they got gathered over there, wouldn't be smart to fly alone on this one, so take a crew with you.

-Stows out

missions.name: Headhunters_BombingRun_Stanton_VH
missions.title: Trapping a Rat
missions.description:
Got a plan to take care of a rat I've been dealing with and need a hand.

Had a client default on some debts and now they've decided they ain't going to pay up. Got a tip that they're hiding out over at [LOCATION]. If you can take out their fuel tanks they'll have no choice but to reconsider their crap decisions.

Just be sure you don't underestimate this slimebag. They might be dumb but they're not stupid, if you get me. I've heard this place is swarming with ships and turrets, you'd have to be a total nullbrain not to bring backup.

-Stows out

missions.name: Headhunters_BombingRun_Stanton_S
missions.title: Outsmarting our Enemies
missions.description:
We've heard news that a new gang are planning an attack on a place over at [LOCATION]. They figure if they can take out the fuel supplies there then it's theirs for the taking.

But little do they know that we're gonna send you in first to blow the fuel tanks so we can claim the place before they do. If it all goes to plan, we can clear the location out and stick it to that gang at the same time. Two birds, one stone.

Only problem is this place is armed to the teeth. Bring a crew and get those fuel tanks out of action. We'll take care of the rest.

-Stows out

missions.name: HH_Pyro_RegionA_E_CFPXSOutposts_BombingRun
missions.title: Take Out Citizens for Prosperity Fuel Supply
missions.description:
It seems like I can't go a day without waking up to one of my people bitchin' and moanin' about how hard Citizens for Prosperity is making their life. 

Eventually we're going wipe those do-gooders out of the system, but for now I'll settle for some peace and quiet. 

Go to [LOCATION] and destroy the fuel stores CFP have got there. That should at least keep them out of our business for a bit.

-Stows out

missions.name: HH_Pyro_RegionA_M_CFPOutposts_Sabotage
missions.title: Wipe Citizens for Prosperity Data Farm
missions.description:
Turns out those Citizens for Prosperity bastards have been gathering intel on us. They're going to try to cut us off from several revenue streams and bleed us dry. Can't let that happen. 

Head to [LOCATION] and destroy their data storage. 

That should teach them not to stick their noses where they don't belong.

-Stows out

missions.name: HH_Pyro_RegionA_M_CFPOutposts_BombingRun
missions.title: Blow Up Citizens for Prosperity Fuel Reserves
missions.description:
I'm getting pretty bloody sick of Citizens for Prosperity sticking their noses where they don't belong. 

Started thinking that it might be pretty nice to ground their fleet for a little bit. We blow up their fuel tanks at [LOCATION] and those little pissheads won't be going nowhere quick.

Sound like your kinda thing?

-Stows out

missions.name: HH_Pyro_RegionA_VH_LastDitch_BombingRunSabotage
missions.title: Stop Rivals from Launching Heist
missions.description:
When will people learn that they can't just do whatever they feel like on Headhunter turf? These idiots are planning a big job and thought that I'd just let them get away with it? No way in hell.

I want you to fly to [LOCATION] and destroy their fuel tanks and data servers. Show them what the Headhunters really think of them.

Let's see them try to pull off anything after that.

-Stows out

missions.name: HH_Pyro_RegionC_CFPXSOutpost_Sabotage
missions.title: Cut Citizens For Prosperity Power
missions.description:
We got big plans about to go down but unfortunately Citizens for Prosperity have people nearby at  [LOCATION].

Since I can't afford to have those bastards cockin' things up for us, I want you to go there and take out their power generators.

Should keep them sidelined until we're done with our business. 

-Stows out

missions.description:
Long story, short - a Headhunter messed up real bad and now Citizens for Prosperity has gotten their hands on some data that could really do some damage to us. 

The bastard is going to need some time to heal so that leaves it to you to clean up the mess. Can you go to [LOCATION] and destroy the servers they got stored there? I wanna make sure there's no chance of this info getting out there.

-Stows out

missions.name: HH_Pyro_RegionB_VH_Shadowfall_Sabotage
missions.title: Purge XenoThreat Servers
missions.description:
I'm so mad right now I can barely see straight. A Headhunter who I thought I could trust just went over to the XenoThreat. Yeah, aliens killed your family. Shit sucks, but you don't turn your back on your people. 

To add insult to injury, the bastard gave XenoThreat a bunch of our intel. I have some other folks tracking the traitor down, but I need you to take care of wiping out the stolen data for me. It's being kept on servers at [LOCATION].

-Stows out

missions.name: HH_DisableCommsTowers_Hard
missions.title: Silence the Xenothreat
missions.description:

In fact, same goes for most other outposts. Rather than having to deal with reinforcements, you can just turn off the comm towers. But hey, if you wanna ring the bell to ghost a few more Xenothreat I ain’t complaining.


Stows out.

missions.name: HH_Pyro_RegionA_E_UnocDerelict_MissingPerson
missions.title: Anybody Seen [TARGET NAME]?
missions.description:
So, I sent one of our people, a new recruit by the name [TARGET NAME], to do a hand-off over at [LOCATION], but now the bastard’s gone missing.

I’m thinking they either ran off with Headhunter credits and they’re good as dead, or they were robbed and now they’re lying there actually good as dead. Either way, I’d like for you to go have a look and see if you can find them.

If you settle the matter, I’ll give you what their cut would have been.

-Stows

missions.name: HH_Pyro_RegionA_M_OccuDerelict_MissingPerson
missions.title: Track Down [TARGET NAME]
missions.description:
Some of my people were involved with a raid over at [LOCATION]. Most of them got out clean, but after the dust settled nobody is sure of what happened to [TARGET NAME].

A lot of other gangs would just leave the poor bastard to rot, but that’s not the way the Headhunters do things. I want to know for sure if [TARGET NAME] is alive or dead and I’m willing to pay you good credits to find out.

Just be careful when you get there because I bet the assholes who live there are still gunning for a fight.

- Stows

missions.name: HH_Pyro_RegionA_E_UnocCave_MissingPerson
missions.title: Track Down [TARGET NAME]
missions.description:
A few days back I dispatched [TARGET NAME] to scope out a cave system for potential use as a storehouse. Haven't heard from them since. 

My gut tells me they ran into trouble. The local wildlife isn't known for being friendly, and [TARGET NAME] isn't exactly known for being cautious. If you're in need of some creds, I'm offering some up for anyone who can get in there and figure out what happened. 

Stows out.

We let 'em go, because we don't betray our own like that, but we're not planning on letting this stand. 

Word is that they fled to their base at [LOCATION]. We need someone to break in, find [TARGET NAME], and relay the info back to me. There's a lot of creds in it for you if you do the job right. 

Keep in mind this isn't their only outpost in the system. If they give you the slip, you may need to track them to another sector. 

Stows out.

missions.name: HH_Pyro_RegionB_VH_MissingPerson_DestroyItem_XT
missions.title: Find Headhunter Crewmember and Help Finish the Job
missions.description:
You ever get a bad feeling that you just can't shake? I had sent [TARGET NAME] to take out the some XenoThreat servers at [LOCATION] and I'm starting think they ran into some serious trouble.

Do me a favor, huh? Go on over and see if you can figure out what happened to them and make sure that those servers are destroyed for good.

-Stows out

missions.name: HH_Pyro_RegionB_H_MissingPerson_DestroyItem_XTXS
missions.title: Find Headhunter Crewmember and Help Finish the Job
missions.description:
I'm a bit at the end of my rope. I had sent [TARGET NAME], a pretty dependable Headhunter, out to destroy the XenoThreat data servers at [LOCATION].

That was a while ago and I still haven't heard from them and the servers are still sitting there intact. 

Do me a favor, huh? Go on over and see if you can figure out what happened to [TARGET NAME] and help finish destroying the servers.

-Stows out

missions.name: HH_Pyro_RegionB_VH_MissingPerson_EliminateAll_XT
missions.title: Unfinished Contract
missions.description:
Here's the deal, one of our usual heavy hitters, a cat named [TARGET NAME], was sent to [LOCATION] to knock out some XenoThreat who'd been hiding there. We knew it was going to be a tall order, but that's why we called in [TARGET NAME]. Problem is, we ain't heard from them.

As far as we know XenoThreat are still operating out of that outpost so we gotta assume that [TARGET NAME] got popped. We need you to go in and finish what they started. Once that's done, if you can find out what happened to [TARGET NAME], that would be a bonus.

Stows out.

missions.name: HH_Pyro_RegionB_H_MissingPerson_EliminateAll_XTXS
missions.title: Should'a left it to a professional
missions.description:
We had this kid named [TARGET NAME] volunteer to go take out some XenoThreat near [LOCATION]. Everything we knew about the place said it was gonna be too much for [TARGET NAME] to handle, but they were real keen on boosting their standing with the Headhunters and thought this would do it, so they went alone.

Haven't heard anything but XenoThreat comms coming out of that place since. If you want to go and knock it over, we'll pay you instead. If you can find out what happened to [TARGET NAME] that would be a bonus.

Stows out.

missions.name: Headhunters_PAF_EliminateAll
missions.title: Show Them Who's Boss
missions.description:
Word’s gotten out that we’re expanding into Stanton and a local crew has hit a few of our safe houses. We managed to track the bastards back to some old Hathor mining site. 

You up for showing them how the Headhunters handle things? If so, head over to [LOCATION] and show them that we mean business. 

 
- Stows

missions.name: Headhunters_PAF_EliminateSpecific
missions.title: Ghost [TARGET NAME]
missions.description:
Can’t believe how many criminals are crawling around this damn system. Guess we’ll have to make some room for ourselves. 

Got a list of high-level leaders here. Nothing brings chaos and disorder to the existing gangs like a good decapitation attack. The next target is [TARGET NAME], who we’ve tracked to [LOCATION]. Feel like ghosting ‘em?   

These old Hathor platform facilities are big and spread out. Doubt there’s a way to do this and not attract the attention of their foot soldiers. Ain’t gonna be easy but sure sounds like fun.

- Stows

missions.name: Headhunters_OLP_EliminateAll
missions.title: Deliver a Message
missions.description:
Surprise, surprise. Seems like not everyone’s happy that the Headhunters are making inroads in Stanton. One crew in particular has been hitting our people and then scurrying back to [LOCATION]. 

Want you to go there and give ‘em a taste of their own medicine. Removing these lickboots should send a pretty clear message about what happens if you screw with us. 


Stows out.

missions.name: HH_Pyro_RegionA_E_DerelictOutpostsCaves_EliminateAll
missions.title: A Swift Reprisal
missions.description:
Hey,

Some two-bit thugs are holed up in [LOCATION]. Wouldn’t pay them any mind, except the arrogant skags tried to hit an outpost under our protection.

We chased 'em off with little trouble, but we can't let that kind of disrespect go unpunished. Our Clips are busy with some bigger fish, so we'd like you to take care of this for us. 

Stows out.

missions.name: HH_Pyro_RegionB_VH_TheGoldenRiviera_EliminateAll
missions.title: Block XenoThreat Expansion
missions.description:
XenoThreat are on the warpath right now. They’ve launched simultaneous attacks on several Headhunters sites and stretched our fighters thin. Got word they’re planning to storm [LOCATION] next, and we can’t get anyone there to defend it. 

I’m looking to pay someone to pull together a crew, gather supplies, and mount a strong defense for us. Gonna be honest with you, this is shaping up to be a hell of a fight. Xenos are sending some of their most experienced forces there. Not much else I can say except that they’ll probably stagger the arrival of their forces, wipe them all out and you’ll be paid handsomely. 

Think you can rise to the occasion?  

-Stows

missions.name: HH_Pyro_RegionB_M_CFPOutposts_EliminateAll
missions.title: [LOCATION] has been greenlit
missions.description:
Word came down from the Judge that we're to hit [LOCATION]. It's owned by CFP and security there have been less than hospitable to some of the locals, so they gotta go.

They may talk a big game about bringing security, but they got guns and are more than happy to use 'em.

Stows out.

missions.name: HH_Pyro_RegionB_E_CFPXSOutposts_EliminateAll
missions.title: Hitting a CFP site
missions.description:
Need someone to sweep [LOCATION]. CFP security forces seized the outpost from a group of locals that'd been there for years. Beat the hell out of 'em from what I heard, so they came to Headhunters asking for revenge. 

Need it done fast and clean. 

Stows out.

missions.name: HH_Pyro_RegionB_VH_ShadowFall_EliminateAll
missions.title: Turf War
missions.description:
One of our Judges caught wind of XenoThreat trying to move in on our territory. Seems like they’re trying to take over [LOCATION]. We don’t want to let those psychos get any more of a foothold in system than they already have, so we’re putting some creds on the line to get ‘em to back off.

We want you to come down on them hard. Don’t let up till the whole place is a graveyard. We’ll send your payment once the bodies are ready to bury.

- Stows out.

missions.name: HH_Pyro_RegionB_H_XTXSOutposts_EliminateAll
missions.title: Hit XenoThreat at [LOCATION]
missions.description:
One of our people stumbled across a group of XenoThreat hiding out over near [LOCATION]. Not sure if they're dug in or just passing through, but we want to hit them before they move.

Maybe bring some people if you got 'em because XenoThreat don't tend to go down easy. Get there and remind them who the power is in this system.

Stows out.

missions.name: HH_Pyro_RegionA_E_1AsteroidBase_Criminals_EliminateAll
missions.title: Need a hitter
missions.description:
So here's the deal, we got some small time dirtbags who think they're hotshots running out of a base near [LOCATION]. I don't know what toxic shit they're drinking but they thought it'd be a good idea to step to some Headhunter Clips. Killed one, injured three more. So I'm looking to send someone there to blast their ambition right out of their skulls.

Head over and get it done. You'll get a nice bump of creds for it.

- Stows

missions.name: HH_Pyro_RegionA_M_2AsteroidBase_Criminals_EliminateAll_RetrieveStolenGoods
missions.title: Death and cargo
missions.description:
Local crew decided to hit one of our convoys and steal our shit. They got away, but we aren't gonna let them celebrate for long. I want you to head out to [LOCATION] where they got a base, blast them into ash, and get our stuff back. 

Once you got the cargo, take it over to [DESTINATION] and we can all forget these assholes ever existed.

Stows out.

missions.name: HH_Pyro_RegionC_DerelictOutpost_EliminateAll
missions.title: Reputation Management
missions.description:
Some assholes are refusing to pay us what we’re owed. Problem is, these idiots are bragging about it. Had they kept it quiet, we could’ve taken care of this more surgically, but now we need to send a message.

The fools are operating from [LOCATION]. We need them all gone. Make it as loud as you can. We’ll send your payment once everyone’s taken care of.

- Stows out.

missions.name: HH_Pyro_RegionD_HHXSOutpost_EliminateAll
missions.title: Green light on [LOCATION]
missions.description:
It's sad to say but we lost one of our outposts to XenoThreat. Appalling if you ask me, but that's why we're looking for someone who's got the time and ammunition to take it back.

If that's you, head over to [LOCATION] and take it back.

Stows out.

missions.name: HH_Pyro_RegionC_CFPXSOutpost_EliminateAll
missions.title: Looking for a little revenge
missions.description:
Here's the deal. Some of those mercs that CFP hired as security went and shot up some Headhunters that were just moving through the system. They weren't even doing anything, just flying.

Anyway, we tracked them back to [LOCATION] and want to dish out some payback. Grab your gear and be our weapon, we'll make it worth your while.

- Stows

missions.name: HH_Pyro_RegionC_HHOutpost_EliminateAll
missions.title: Back up needed at outpost
missions.description:
Those XenoThreat punks launched an attack against [LOCATION] so we're looking for people to go fend them off. 

Get out there and waste every XenoThreat you see.

Stows out.

missions.name: HH_Pyro_RegionC_CFPXSOutposts_ChainEliminateAll
missions.title: Time to roll on CFP
missions.description:
Looking for anyone with an itchy trigger finger. We're looking to move against some CFP at  [LOCATION] and take it for ourselves. You gotta play this smart though. There are a bunch of satellite outposts around the main one and all of 'em got security, so you should take out each of these before you take the main base.

But hey, if you wanna jump right in the deep end and fight off all the reinforcements, that's on you. As long as you get it done.

Stows out.

missions.name: HH_Pyro_RegionD_XTXSOutposts_ChainEliminateAll
missions.title: Go on the warpath
missions.description:
Looking for some hitters to go drop some violence on some local dipshits who've been pulling jobs in the system against Headhunters. We tried reaching out to explain the error of their ways, but they shot our messenger, so now we go with option B.

You'll find them holed up near [LOCATION]. Go there and repaint the walls with their blood.

Have fun.

Stows out.

missions.name: HH_Pyro_RegionB_M_ChainElimAll_1Cluster_AttackXT
missions.title: Taking out some XenoThreat trash
missions.description:
Just got clearance from my Judge to start banging back against XenoThreat. Been eyeballing some spots under their control near [LOCATION].

I'll give you the targets to hit, you kill everyone you find. Hell, I'd love to go myself, sounds like fun.

-Stows

missions.name: HH_Pyro_RegionB_E_ChainElimAll_1Cluster_AttackCFP
missions.title: A little retaliation
missions.description:
Been getting word that CFP security have been getting a little more aggressive and started pushing people out of the homes they've built out of the scrap in the system and they want payback, so they came to us.

Head out to [LOCATION] and clear out the CFP there. Should be pretty cut and dry with a nice payday.

Stows out.

missions.name: HH_Pyro_RegionB_M_ChainElimAll_1Cluster_ElimSpec_AttackCFP
missions.title: Driving CFP out
missions.description:
We've been trying to play nice with these Citizens for Prosperity people, but they've made it abundantly clear that we don't have a place in their 'safe system.' Their use of mercs for security have been causing all kinds of unreasonable violence like when this asshole [TARGET NAME] opened fire on a group of settlers to drive them away from an outpost they'd been eyeing. So now the gloves are coming off.

I need some hard workers to go hit [LOCATION] and take out [TARGET NAME]. Odds are, they'll stay hidden until you prove you're enough of a threat, so make sure you do some damage.

Stows out.

missions.name: HH_Pyro_RegionB_H_ChainElimAll_2Cluster_ElimSpec_AttackCFP
missions.title: Sweep and clear some CFP haunts
missions.description:
Got word from my Judge that we're to take back some of the outposts that CFP have taken over. They're a little pissed that CFP's getting as much of a foothold in the system as they are and think it's making the Headhunters look weak.

Found a couple candidates near [LOCATION] that could use a sweep. Icing on the cake is that the head of security there is [TARGET NAME]. Not sure if you've heard of 'em, but they shot up a handful of Clips last month, so it's a win-win. Get some territory back and punch out someone who could really stand to get got.

Stows out.

missions.name: HH_Pyro_RegionB_VH_ChainElimAll_3Cluster_ElimSpec_AttackCFP
missions.title: Hit a CFP Complex
missions.description:
Got a big one here. We need a team to head out to [LOCATION]. Word is CFP are dug in at three different clusters in the area. Our judge wants them all cleared out. Seems one of their mercs, a real mean skag named [TARGET NAME], is holed up at one of them. We want you to go there, clear them all out and take out [TARGET NAME].

Get yourself a nice little payday in the process.

Stows out.

missions.name: HH_Pyro_RegionB_H_ChainElimAll_2Cluster_ElimSpec_AttackXT
missions.title: Taking XenoThreat Turf
missions.description:
Need some good soldiers with a taste for violence to hit some XenoThreat hideouts located around [LOCATION]. I'll get you the specifics if you're down, but you'll have to wipe out two separate clusters of hideouts. 

We've also gotten word that [TARGET NAME] is lurking around down there. If you take out enough XenoThreat dirtbags, they'll pop they're head up. 

When they do, put a round in it.

Stows out.

missions.name: HH_Pyro_RegionB_VH_ChainElimAll_3Cluster_ElimSpec_AttackXT
missions.title: Taking down a XenoThreat Hideout
missions.description:
Got a juicy assignment for any big-time enforcers who want to clear a big payday. Over at [LOCATION] we got some XenoThreat turf run by a real bastard named [TARGET NAME]. Now if you've been in the system long enough, you've probably either heard of [TARGET NAME] or at least seen their work. Skag has a tendency to leaves bodies wherever they go.

Anyway, Judge wants this area swept clean, that means you gotta hit all three clusters and kill every XenoThreat dirt you find. Kill enough and [TARGET NAME] won't be able to hide.

Take them all out and have one on us.

Stows out.

missions.name: HH_Pyro_RegionA_VH_3AsteroidBase_XenoThreat_MultiEliminateAll_Boss
missions.title: Hit on XenoThreat command
missions.description:
These XenoThreat assholes are like aloprats. Every time you thing you wipe them out, they just pop back up again. They seem to be back to their usual shit and trying to put together something big. No idea what, but we've been cleared to stop it before it starts.

A group of XenoThreat biggies are supposedly meeting at [LOCATION] to plan or just rage or whatever it is they do, but we're gonna bust it up. Or you are.

Head over there and wipe out everyone you find. Sure enough I'm sure the biggies will jump into the fight. That's what they always do.

This'll be a tough one. As much as I hate XenoThreat, they're damn good in a fight, so watch yourself and bring help if you can.

Stows out.

missions.name: Vaughn_Nyx_Assassination_Intro
missions.title: A Chance to Impress
missions.description:
Firstly, allow me to introduce myself. To put it rather dramatically, I deal in lives. 

People hire me when some soul needs to be extinguished, and I in return employ the perfect person to serve as the extinguishant. This provides security to all parties involved as none know the identity of the other. An ideal situation as far as these things go.

I was recently made aware that you may possess skills that would make you of service to me and decided that it would be worthwhile to pursue the validity of this claim. 
 
If you have any interest in forging a working relationship, I will need a demonstration of said skills. 

Seek out and discreetly kill [TARGET NAME] over at [LOCATION].

Do so successfully and you will be rewarded. Not only that, but you will have proven yourself worthy of further consideration.

Sincerely,
Vaughn

missions.name: Vaughn_Nyx_Assassination_Rehire
missions.title: Another Chance to Impress
missions.description:
It is not often in life that we get another chance to make a first impression, but I am going to provide to you with just that.

To say I was disappointed in how things last transpired on your last assassination attempt would be a severe understatement. However, here is your chance to prove yourself capable of more. 

Kill [TARGET NAME] over at [LOCATION] and I will consider the slate wiped clean. 

Sincerely,
Vaughn

missions.name: Vaughn_EliminateSpecific_Standard
missions.title: They Will Be Missed
missions.description:
A security officer by the name of [TARGET NAME] is in desperate need of an early retirement. They are currently stationed at [LOCATION] along with a host of other eager types in uniforms. 

Feel free to indulge your violent whims, but it is only the death of [TARGET NAME] which will earn you my credit and thanks.

Earnestly,
Vaughn

missions.name: Vaughn_EliminateSpecific_EliminateCompetionWorkers
missions.title: All Things Come To An End
missions.description:
They say there is no honor among thieves. Today, it seems, you're targeting one of your own. 

Please head to [LOCATION] and kill [TARGET NAME]. What you do with the others there is entirely up to you.

Earnestly,
Vaughn

missions.name: Vaughn_Rockcracker_Power_EliminateSpecific
missions.title: A Well Deserved Break
missions.description:
A request has made its way to my desk regarding the untimely end of one [TARGET NAME], a member of the Claw Salamander who is currently scuttling around an old QV Breaker Station. 

It is highly likely that you will find them at [LOCATION].  Be mindful though that with a station this large it may take a bit of searching to track them down. 

Hope you enjoy your time in Nyx,
Vaughn

missions.name: Vaughn_Rockcracker_Maintenance_EliminateSpecific
missions.title: A Well Deserved Break
missions.description:
I've been having a hard time tracking this target down. They're part of a gang known as the Claw Salamanders who tend to be quite itinerate. However, it seems the group has been trying to get an old QV Breaker Station operational again and I think this just may be the chance to take out [TARGET NAME] once and for all. 

Start your search at [LOCATION].  These stations can apparently be quiet cavernous at  times so it may take a bit of effort to locate the target once you're on site.

However, I have all the confidence in your abilities,
Vaughn

missions.name: Vaughn_Rockcracker_Opsroom_EliminateSpecific
missions.title: A Well Deserved Break
missions.description:
There is a member of the Nyx gang the Claw Salamanders, [TARGET NAME], who has made it on to my naughty list. They had been on the run for quite awhile, but just recently popped back up at an old mining station in the Keeger Belt. Our lucky day shall be their last.  

Word is that you can find them at [LOCATION].  Unfortunately, there is a strong chance you may have to do some repairs to the station itself before you can gain access to that particular area.

But I'm sure you're more than up to the challenge.

Sincerely,
Vaughn

missions.name: Vaughn_EliminateBoss_Standard
missions.title: They Will Be Missed
missions.description:
A senior security official by the name of [TARGET NAME] is about to have their long career come to a very violent and sudden end. While they are currently at [LOCATION], they will not be easy to get to. I fear that a bit of work will be required to draw them out.  

I recommend killing enough of their underlings that they will be forced to face you personally. Of course, once they do decide to finally show their face, it should be a rather straightforward matter. 

Earnestly,
Vaughn

missions.name: Vaughn_EliminateBoss_EliminateCompetionWorkers
missions.title: All Things Come To An End
missions.description:
I am not sure if you’re acquainted with [LOCATION], but [TARGET NAME] is the one who calls the shots there. I need them eliminated.

That is easier said then done, I'm afraid. They are notoriously reluctant to see to matters personally, preferring their underlings to handle the dirty work. That said, eliminate enough of the underlings and they will have no choice but to deal with you themselves.

Earnestly,
Vaughn

missions.name: UnafilliatedHH_Pyro_RegionA_E_1AsteroidBase_Criminals_ShipHeist
missions.title: Easy Pickings
missions.description:

missions.name: GillysPilotSchool_Mission01
missions.title: Combat Gauntlet - Scenario #1
missions.description:
Looking to gain critical hands-on experience battling a variety of targets and situations? Then my Combat Gauntlet might be the perfect fit for you.

Please understand that this course is intended for pilots who have already mastered flying basics and are ready to take their abilities to the next level. If you’re starting off and want to learn the ropes, I’d recommend logging some hours in an Arena Commander simpod. But for those ready to face a real challenge, I firmly believe that students learn best by doing. 

That’s why I’ve designed these eight scenarios to be as realistic as possible. I promise you this is the closest thing to Navy combat pilot training you can get without enlisting, so don’t expect a lot of hand holding. The risk of injury to yourself or your ship should be taken very seriously.

GAUNTLET SCENARIOS:
1. Single Targets
2. Multiple Targets
3. Target Priority
4. Target Stealth
5. Missiles and Countermeasures
6. Multi-Crew Targets
7. Corvette with Escorts
8. Capital Ship Encounter

So, if you’re ready to challenge yourself and prove you got what it takes to be a great pilot, the first scenario will focus on handling a single target. Head to [LOCATION] to begin.

As a bonus, successful completion of the scenario will net the original contractor holder an award of [SCRIP AMOUNT] MG Scrip.

TRICKS OF THE TRADE:
- Situational Awareness – Don’t get so focused on taking a target that you aren’t watching your flight path. No good taking out the enemy if you fly headfirst into an asteroid.

Good luck out there, 
Instructor Gilly    


ABOUT GILLY’S FLIGHT SCHOOL 
Instructor Lucas “Gilly” Baramsco has served in six squadrons and has over ten years of teaching experience. Whether a student with zero flight experience or a professional looking to polish their skills, Gilly Flight School offers a variety of courses to “Launch Your Piloting Career.”

itemRewards.name: Carryable 1h Cy Physical Currency Scrip Merc 1

missions.name: GillysPilotSchool_Mission02
missions.title: Combat Gauntlet - Scenario #2
missions.description:
Congrats on completing part one of this eight-part course.

Scenario two will focus on how to deal with multiple targets at the same time. Goal here is give you a better handle on how to balance offense and defense.   

Whenever you’re set, grab a combat ship, and head to [LOCATION] to begin.

As a bonus, successful completion of the scenario will net the original contractor holder an award of [SCRIP AMOUNT] MG Scrip.

TRICKS OF THE TRADE:
- Pick Your Fight - For situations where you’re coming up against multiple targets of equal threat, your best strategy is to focus on neutralizing one target at a time to gradually reduce the amount of incoming fire.

Good luck out there, 
Instructor Gilly     


ABOUT GILLY’S FLIGHT SCHOOL

missions.name: GillysPilotSchool_Mission03
missions.title: Combat Gauntlet - Scenario #3
missions.description:
Congrats on completing part two of this eight-part course.   

The third scenario throws tactical considerations into the mix. This time around the attacking ships are from distinct classes with distinct battlefield applications. Knowing what targets to prioritize is vital to surviving engagements against multiple ships.      

Whenever you’re ready, head to [LOCATION] to get started.

As a bonus, successful completion of the scenario will net the original contractor holder an award of [SCRIP AMOUNT] MG Scrip.

TRICKS OF THE TRADE:
- Bigger They Are – Try to evaluate which threat is the most dangerous and take them out first.
- Shields – If you’re taking a lot of damage, don’t be afraid to boost away and let your shields regenerate.

Good luck out there, 
Instructor Gilly

missions.name: GillysPilotSchool_Mission04
missions.title: Combat Gauntlet - Scenario #4
missions.description:
Congrats on completing part three of this eight-part course.

Good combat pilots know not all threats are apparent. It’s the threats you don’t expect that can be the most devastating. Scenario four is focused on how to identify and deal with stealth targets. Hopefully by the end, you’ll understand just how important your radar is in determining who you’re really up against. Expect to have regular and stealth ships hunting you down.    

Make your way to [LOCATION] whenever you’re ready, and remember to keep your eyes on your radar.

As a bonus, successful completion of the scenario will net the original contractor holder an award of [SCRIP AMOUNT] MG Scrip.

TRICKS OF THE TRADE:
- Surprise Attacks - Pinging your surroundings can sometimes reveal hidden ships. Be ready for contacts to show up unexpectedly.

Good luck out there, 
Instructor Gilly

missions.name: GillysPilotSchool_Mission05
missions.title: Combat Gauntlet - Scenario #5
missions.description:
Congrats on completing part four of this eight-part course.   

The fifth scenario focuses on defensive tactics. Knowing when to take evasive measures and deploy either decoys or noise countermeasures is essential to your survival. That’s why the aggressors in this exercise will be armed with missiles.   

Ensure your countermeasures are fully stocked and then go to [LOCATION] to start.

As a bonus, successful completion of the scenario will net the original contractor holder an award of [SCRIP AMOUNT] MG Scrip.

TRICKS OF THE TRADE:
- Ready to Launch - Easy access to your decoys and countermeasures can be critical in your success in dealing with incoming missile fire. 
- Stand and Fight - Resist the temptation to hit the afterburner to escape as you’ll increase your signature and make it easier for the missile to hit you. They’re almost certainly much faster than you anyway.
- Close the Gap – While it may seem counterintuitive, getting closer to an enemy ship can be an advantage. Missiles have a minimum range and if you’re inside of it they won’t be able to get a lock on you.

Good luck out there, 
Instructor Gilly

missions.name: GillysPilotSchool_Mission06
missions.title: Combat Gauntlet - Scenario #6
missions.description:
Congrats on completing part five of this eight-part course.

I’m bringing out the big guns for scenario six. Time for you to go up against larger, multi-crewed ships, which provide a few new challenges. Not only will you have to contend with their enhanced firepower but their multifaceted shields means you’ll have to target one shield face continually to do real damage. Easier said than done when both of y’all are moving at such fast speeds.      

Find your way to [LOCATION] whenever you're ready.

As a bonus, successful completion of the scenario will net the original contractor holder an award of [SCRIP AMOUNT] MG Scrip. 

TRICKS OF THE TRADE:
- Size Advantage – When going up against a larger ship, try to stay away from their front as typically this is where the majority of their offensive fire is located. 

Good luck out there, 
Instructor Gilly

missions.name: GillysPilotSchool_Mission07
missions.title: Combat Gauntlet - Scenario #7
missions.description:
Congrats on completing part six of this eight-part course.

You’ve gained a lot of experience across the past six scenarios, and now it’s time to put it all to practice. Scenario seven puts you up against a corvette-class ship and its escorts. This extended encounter will push you to the limit and test everything you got.   

The only thing left is to understand the limit of your skillset. To put it simply, you can’t do everything yourself. Developing and maintaining relationships with fellow pilots that you can call upon for support is really the last piece of the puzzle. Not saying you can't overcome encounters like this by yourself, but even the Navy doesn’t send their ace pilots on a patrol alone.    

Once you decided whether to do this alone or call in some support, head over to [LOCATION] to kick off the encounter.

As a bonus, successful completion of the scenario will net the original contractor holder an award of [SCRIP AMOUNT] MG Scrip.

TRICKS OF THE TRADE
- Strength in Diversity – Think about the roles your allies will be filling and choose who to bring carefully to help balance strengths and weaknesses. You’ll want ships capable of taking on the Corvette while others deal with the escort.

Good luck out there, 
Instructor Gilly

missions.title: Combat Gauntlet - Scenario #8
missions.description:
Welcome to the final scenario of the Combat Gauntlet.

Throughout this course, you’ve gotten to experience the advanced combat and defensive tactics needed to survive a variety of encounters. Time to take all those new skills and knowledge and see how they hold up against a large capital vessel and some escort ships.

You know the drill by now. Once you and all your allies are set, find your way to [LOCATION] to see how you do when truly pushed to the limits.

As a bonus, successful completion of the scenario will net the original contractor holder an award of [SCRIP AMOUNT] MG Scrip.

TRICKS OF THE TRADE
- Patience is a Virtue – If you’ve balanced your squadron properly, you should be able to come out on top, just don’t expect it to be a quick fight. Ships this big don’t go down quickly.

Good luck out there, 
Instructor Gilly

missions.title: Adagio Holdings in Need of Salvagers
missions.description:
Adagio Holdings
A Proud Equal Opportunity Employer

> About us <
As the leading procurer and distributor of salvage rights, Adagio Holdings are now looking to expand into the acquisition and distribution of salvageable materials to both small and large-scale businesses.

> About the job <
As a part of this initiative, we need keen-eyed contractors capable of identifying salvageable materials, efficiently stripping them, and delivering the Recycle Material Composite (RMC) and salvaged components to us.

This introductory contract will require you to head to [LOCATION] and strip an abandoned ship approved for salvage.

Once you've gathered the RMC, you'll deliver it to the freight elevator located at [DESTINATION].

> Requirements <
     - Any class/size of salvage ship

For advice on salvaging, consult A Salvager's Guide to Material Collection in your mobiGlas journal.

> Disclaimer <
Contractors are responsible for ensuring that they are collecting materials from vehicles that are considered fair salvage under the pursuant UEE laws. Adagio Holdings is in no way liable for any crimes or misdemeanors committed by contractors and will offer no compensation or reparation for any persons affected by these actions.

missions.name: Shubin_RG_Discovery_FPSMine_Nyx_Rank1_MediumQuantity_Sadaryx
missions.title: Small Mining Order: Sadaryx
missions.description:
CONTRACT: Mining Order
LOCATION: Nyx

DETAILS:
One of our prospecting teams recently confirmed that the asteroids which house QV Breaker Stations throughout Nyx's Keeger Belt contain a rare ore type, Sadaryx.

However, owing to the difficulty in access these stations and the inherent risks involved, we are seeking external mining crews to handle the extraction.

We do not have a confirmed location of where the Sadaryx deposits are located within the station, but would recommend starting with the cave sections where minerals naturally form. If you get really lucky, you may even find some crystals in storage that were mined by the old QV work crews.

TERMS*:
Your crew will need to gain access to a QV Breaker Station, collect the required Sadaryx ore, and deliver it to the freight elevator located at [DESTINATION].

This will require a Multi-Tool with a Mining Attachment and a basic understanding of hand mining.

Our prospecting teams have reported that these stations may have been infiltrated by outlaws. Caution is advised.

*By accepting this contract you are assuming any and all risks associated with the work outlined herein and in no way can Shubin Interstellar be held accountable for any damages accrued during the duration of the contract.

missions.name: Shubin_RG_Discovery_FPSMine_Nyx_Rank1_SadaryxLenses
missions.title: Supply Order: Sadaryx Focus Lenses
missions.description:
CONTRACT: Manufacturing Order
LOCATION: Nyx

DETAILS:
If you happen to have any other work bringing you to one of the QV Breaker Stations in the Keeger Belt, Shubin Interstellar would be highly interested in contracting you to obtaining a supply of hard-to-source mining laser focus lenses.

TERMS*:
While there may be some focus lenses that can be recovered from the QV Breaker Station's storage, you must likely will need to manufacture them using Sadaryx crystals and the on-site lens fabricator. While the ore is rare, these Breaker Stations typically have sadaryx veins that can be mined directly with a Multi-Tool with a Mining Attachment.

missions.name: RCD_Exclusive
missions.title: QV Breaker Station Mining Rights (Exclusive)
missions.description:
CONTRACT: Mining Rights Transfer
LOCATION: Nyx

DETAILS:
Shubin Interstellar prospectors have recently discovered the location of an abandoned QV Planetary Service Breaker Station near the Keeger belt. These stations were originally used by the defunct company to harvest valuable resources from inside asteroids but knowledge of their exact locations has been lost over the years. 

While this particular station is offline, our scout team believes that it could be made functional again with the necessary repairs. Additionally, if it was brought back online, there's already a resource-heavy asteroid in place ready to be cracked by the station's mining laser. 

Unfortunately, with all the various challenges that come with operating in Nyx, Shubin doesn't currently have the available bandwidth to handle the aforementioned repairs ourselves. This however has created an opportunity for an interested independent mining operation such as yourself. 

TERMS*: 
We are making available the exclusive mining rights to this QV Breaker Station. Upon purchase, we will provide the coordinates of the station to only you and your crew. Your team will then be free to head there with a mining vessel, restore the station's mining laser to an operational status, crack the asteroid, and harvest the resources inside. 

Please note that while we guarantee that these coordinates will be exclusive to you, we cannot assure that other interested parties, such as outlaws, may not discover the station's location on their own. Caution is advised. 

*By accepting this contract you are assuming any and all risks associated with the work outlined herein and in no way can Shubin Interstellar be held accountable for any damages accrued during the duration of the contract.

missions.name: Ship_Refueling_Intro_Stanton
missions.title: UWC'S HIRING REFUELERS
missions.description:
Hey!

DD from the United Wayfarers Club here.

The UWC offers repair, rearming and refuelling services across the UEE. It just so happens that we're on the look-out for new affiliates whose ships are fitted for refuelling. If you've got the fuel pods and like it when people are pleased to see you, the UWC might be the club for you.

And if you think it might be, I've got a live beacon you might like.

If you do happen to like it, a word to the wise: make sure your fuel pods are full before you head out.

A Club member has run out of fuel at [LOCATION]. I'm not sure on the details, like how they ended up out there with no Go Juice, but the UWC doesn't like to leave folk hanging.

The client vessel will pay you at the rate of [FUEL RATE] aUEC per SCU of Hydrogen and  [QTFUEL RATE] aUEC per SCU of Quantum . As a United Wayfarers Club contractor, you will also qualify for the UWC service fee listed above upon completion.

It's a straightforward run. Perfect if you want to get a feel for this kind of job. Get out there, fill up the tanks of their [SHIP] and get them on their way. Do enough runs like this, and the process becomes muscle memory. Until then, there's a journal entry on your mobiGlas called ""Refueling Protocols"" that covers the basics.

There have been no reports of outlaw activity in that sector, but stay alert. I always recommend you aim for a fast turnaround. The sooner you're done, the sooner I can fix you up with another contract. UWC's always looking for new affiliates. 

Looking forward to working with you.

Dina Deloit
Dispatch Hub
United Wayfarers Club
"We’ve got your back"

missions.name: Refueling_Stanton_Hard
missions.title: CRITICAL REFUEL REQUEST: [SHIP]
missions.description:
Hi,

Another day another beacon. There's a [SHIP] with an empty tank at [LOCATION].  The client vessel will pay you at the rate of [FUEL RATE] aUEC per SCU of Hydrogen and  [QTFUEL RATE] aUEC per SCU of Quantum , and as a United Wayfarers Club contractor, you will also qualify for the UWC service fee listed above upon completion.

I can't lie: it's a nasty place to get stuck and a worse place to get caught by surprise. We've lost good people out there - even the ones who got lucky made it home with pieces missing.

Just do the job and get home safe, okay?

Dina Deloit

missions.name: Firesale_CFP
missions.title: Strategic Detatrine Reserve – Small Resupply
missions.description:
Following the brutal attack on Pyro and our efforts to combat the vigilante group the Frontier Fighters, our strategic reserves across the system are at an all-time low. Citizens for Prosperity are eager to replenish our stocks before we reach a point of desperation. 

To that end, we were hoping that you would be able to resupply [DESTINATION] with detatrine. 

This rare chemical compound is a key ingredient in several vital medical supplies, so it is important that replace what we used up treating local civilians and CFP members injured in the wake of the Frontier Fighter assault.

Normally we would direct you to reputable sources to acquire detatrine, but our contacts have informed us that several depots around the system have suddenly decided to sell the chemical at a significantly reduced price. In fact, it’s inexpensive enough that I suspect it will draw some unwanted attention. If you decide to seek out this potentially deadly deal, please do so with caution.

Your support of our efforts is much appreciated,

Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity

missions.name: Firesale_HH
missions.title: Out of Detatrine – Small Resupply
missions.description:
Kicking the crap out of those Frontier Fighter bastards seriously depleted our supplies and now our stash of detatrine is practically out of stock. 

That’s why you’re going to do a detatrine resupply run to [DESTINATION]. 

Not sure if you’re familiar with it, but the chemical’s what we use to make our batches of sludge. We can’t really afford to let our sales of the stuff dry up right now. Not when we need credits so bad.

The good news is that depots across the system are offering detatrine and rock-bottom prices. Hell if I know why they’re doing it, all I know is that everyone with a lick of sense is trying to get their hands on the stuff so be ready for fierce competition. 

I’m trustin’ you to get it done,
Stows

missions.description:
*FOR IMMEDIATE SYSTEM-WIDE RELEASE*

This is a call to arms for all available Civilian Defense Force volunteers. An RSI Polaris corvette on its way to Invictus Launch Week festivities has been hijacked by the terrorist organization the Frontier Fighters. Initial intelligence reports indicate they’re attempting to escape into the Pyro system.

The Navy has officially requested for any CDF volunteers to help provide combat support immediately to neutralize this threat and prevent the Frontier Fighters from escaping with the stolen capital ship. SAIC Rowena Dulli from the Advocacy is the official attaché to the CDF and will be running the operation.

missions.name: UEEVisitTheHalls_SimpleObjective
missions.title: Happy Invictus
missions.description:
Hello Citizens and Civilians,

The United Empire of Earth is proud to acknowledge the start of this year's Invictus ceremony. Originally started in 2542, the United Planets of Earth dispatched Naval ships to each of the settled planets to pick up the latest group of volunteers entering military service.

Now, over four hundred years later, Invictus continues this proud tradition of celebrating those among us who are standing up for others and protecting the Empire as well as showcasing the latest additions to the Naval fleet.

This year's festivities can be found on ArcCorp in Stanton and feature a great hall with some of the newest ships on display as well as the new Idris Experience Tour where you can tour an active-duty Idris, accessible at the top of the IO-North tower.

Accept this contract if you would like guidance to the festivities. As a special thank you, in partnership with the Mercenary Guild, attendees will be awarded [SCRIP AMOUNT] scrip.

Thank you and enjoy your Invictus.

missions.title: Navy Patrol Training – Scenario #1
missions.description:
If travelling to different star systems around the Empire, helping those in need, and protecting our borders sounds like a rewarding career to you, then maybe you’re ready to become a pilot in the UEE Navy.

The overall demand for naval pilots has increased in recent years which means there’s now more opportunity than ever before. However, to become a Navy pilot, you need to go through specialist training and gain many hours of flight experience.

To give you a small taste of what life as a combat pilot would be like, Gilly’s Flight School has partnered with the UEE Navy to offer a unique opportunity to take a special Patrol Training course that will run you through three scenarios covering a basic patrol. 

SIGN UP NOW FOR SCENARIO #1 – Scanning a Patrol Point

I believe that folks learn best by doing, so don’t expect a lot of hand holding out there. This is about throwing you into the deep end and giving you a chance to swim. You never know what you’re capable of until you’re given the chance.

As a bonus on completion of the scenario, the original contract holder will be awarded [SCRIP AMOUNT] MG Scrip. Plus, completing all three will get you a special keepsake.

Can’t wait to see you out there,
Instructor Gilly

missions.name: CleanAir_Small_ResourceGathering_Research_Ice
missions.title: Alliance Aid: Small Supply of Research Resource
missions.description:
To all available contractors,

Rayari needs your assistance. As part of the Alliance Aid effort, our scientists have shifted their entire focus to assisting Levski deal with Molina mold. Unfortunately, the team’s progress has stalled due to a lack of a key resource.

Obtaining it from our regular distributors could take weeks. Considering how many people desperately need help, stopping research for that long would seriously impact our effort. We’re hoping to find motivated individuals willing to procure and deliver a small scale haul of it for delivery to [DESTINATION]. 

Please remember that contracted goods are tracked by their legal owners and can't be accepted. 

Together we can make the universe better for all.

Narina Lerrem
Senior Manager
Clinical Research Outsourcing

LOCATION: Pyro System, Stanton System

We’ve just received word from our facility at [DESTINATION] that their stockpile of a vital resource is getting low. Our normal supplier won’t be able to do a resupply run for a while, so we’re hoping you might be able to do a small scale run of it now to bridge the gap.

missions.title: Alliance Aid: Vital Package Retrieval
missions.description:
ATTENTION ALL FTL COURIERS
FOR IMMEDIATE ASSIGNMENT

**CONTRACT DETAILS** 

PICKUP LOCATION – An FTL ship carrying a delivery for Alliance Aid has not completed it's contract. The last known location has it still over at [LOCATION]. A courier needed to retrieve package and continue delivery.

DROPOFF LOCATION – Package must be taken to [DESTINATION]. 

THREAT LEVEL – It is unclear what happened to the ship, but we expect a malfunction. Still, caution is advised. Low level engagements expected.

TRAVEL –  All transportation needs should be arranged by courier. 

FTL Courier Services is proud to be assisting in Alliance Aid efforts to help fight the Levski outbreak.
