missions.name: CleanAir_System-To-System_SingleToMulti_Transport-Milestone
missions.title: Alliance Aid: Double Interstellar Med. Haul (Medical / Filters)
missions.description:
All right, this one is going to be a bit different. See, with everything going on with Alliance Aid, we had a screw up with our contracts and an important shipment got overlooked. Since lives are at stake, and you've already done so much to help the Transport Division, I was kinda hoping that you'd be able to step up and do a double run for us?

There's a medium scale haul of Molina Mold treatment on microtech and shipment of ventilation filters on Hurston waiting for pick-up. You'll need to make both stops, load up everything, and bring it all to [DESTINATION]. 
 
To handle the cargo, your ship should be big enough to carry cargo containers up to [MISSION MAX SCUSIZE] in size. 

And I would double check to make sure you have your handheld tractor beam with you before heading out. Would be a huge headache if you forgot to bring one!  

It's really amazing of you to be helping out like this,

Ella Tieno 
Jr. Logistics Coordinator 
Covalex Shipping  
'Anything you need, anywhere you need it.'

missions.name: CleanAir_ResourceGathering_Research_MolinaMold
missions.title: Alliance Aid: Molina Mold Samples
missions.description:
Let me start by saying that your continuing work helping the Alliance Aid efforts so far have made a considerable difference not only to us at Rayari, but to the rest of the organizations coordinating with the Collections Division. It's why I wanted to reach out to you directly. 

While we have been making great strides in combating this ongoing health crisis, there is concern amongst our researchers that Molina Mold has the potential to mutate into a new fungal strain. 
In order in ensure that our ongoing investigation into the mold is as accurate as possible, we would like you to head to the source of the growth in Levski and  harvest new samples of the Molina Mold  there directly. 

Once you have the samples collected, you will then need to deliver them to [DESTINATION]. 

Thank you for your assistance at this vital juncture. 

Narina Lerrem
Senior Manager
Clinical Research Outsourcing

missions.name: CleanAir_RecoverCargo_VIP
missions.title: Alliance Aid: Urgent Rescue Mission
missions.description:
Since you've been doing so much work helping out the Defense Division I wanted to come to you with this contract direct. It's a bit of a delicate one. Two VIPs fell ill and the worry was that if word got out they were being transported they would become major targets.

Unfortunately, it seems that's exactly what happened. Our attempts to smuggle them from Nyx to Stanton for medical treatment have failed, and now the ship carrying them is under attack. 

We need you to hurry to [LOCATION], neutralize the attackers and ensure that the cryopods make it safely to the freight elevator at [DESTINATION]. 

In fact, I want you to make sure you have a ship that can carry the cryopods just in case their original transport is too damaged to go on.

I sincerely hope you manage to pull this rescue mission off. 

Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity

missions.name: HaulCargo_AToB_Intro
missions.title: Opportunity for Independent Cargo Hauler
missions.description:
Earning such accolades as 'Imperial Finances' Top 10 Shipping Companies' and 'Delivery Digest's 2945's Most Trusted Transport,' Covalex is busier than ever. And that means more cargo going to more places. That's where you come in.  

Covalex is looking for dependable and industrious pilots to join our expanding family. Do you have access to a ship that can hold [MISSION MAX SCUSIZE] cargo containers? Can you pass an Advocacy background check if required? Then a universe of opportunity is waiting for you. 

Simply complete an 'Evaluation Trial’ by picking up a shipment of [ITEM] from a freight elevator at [LOCATION] and successfully delivering it to a freight elevator at [DESTINATION].

Upon satisfactory completion, you'll be eligible to become part of Covalex Shipping's vast network of independent transport specialists*.

By the way, we strongly encourage contractors to bring a handheld tractor beam along.   


Covalex Shipping  
'Anything you need, anywhere you need it.'







*Covalex Shipping is a limited liability corporation. To encourage timely deliveries and prevent fraud on cargo hauls, Covalex Shipping will set a delivery time limit and upon expiration, any undelivered cargo will be considered stolen and treated as such. Total payment will be prorated according to the percentage of cargo successfully delivered.

missions.name: HaulCargo_SingleToMulti3_Processed_Stims_SmallGrade
missions.title: [REPUTATION RANK] Rank - [CARGO GRADE TOKEN] Cargo Haul
missions.description:
Hi,

There’s a load of stims at [LOCATION] ready to be picked up from a freight elevator and delivered to a few spots. They will be packaged up in containers [MISSION MAX SCUSIZE] or smaller. Any chance you can knock this one out for me? 

Doesn’t matter what order you drop them off.    

DROP OFF LOCATIONS (ANY ORDER)

[SINGLE TO MULTI TOKEN]

Glad I never picked up the habit myself because I swear I get more delivery update requests for “where are my stims?!?” than any other kind of shipment. 

By the way, we strongly encourage contractors to bring a handheld tractor beam along.   

[CONTRACTOR]

Chase Hewitt
Jr. Logistics Coordinator
Covalex Shipping  
'Anything you need, anywhere you need it.'







Covalex Shipping is a limited liability corporation. To encourage timely deliveries and prevent fraud on cargo hauls, Covalex Shipping will set a delivery time limit and upon expiration, any undelivered cargo will be considered stolen and treated as such. Total payment will be prorated according to the percentage of cargo successfully delivered.

missions.name: PU_MultiElimAllAndBoss_DC_Stanton-S4LD01
missions.title: Secure Bounty: [TARGET NAME] (VHRT)
missions.description:
ABOUT THE JOB
microTech Protection Services is looking for a qualified bounty hunter to apprehend [TARGET NAME] who has so far been able to evade capture. They are coordinating an active raid that has spread throughout [LOCATION].  

Our hope is that you may be able to finally draw them out of hiding if you confront their forces at several different attack points. With their numbers sufficiently weakened, [TARGET NAME] will most likely risk exposure and you will be able to confront them directly.

RESPONSIBILITIES
• Provide own transportation to [LOCATION].
•Confront [TARGET NAME]’s criminal associates to draw the target into the open.
• Neutralize [TARGET NAME]; using force if necessary.

MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS
• Access to combat equipment and mode of transport.
• Available for immediate deployment.

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS
• Ability to handle high pressure situations.

missions.name: PU_MultiElimAllAndBoss_DC_Stanton_Sakurasun-Magnolia
missions.title: Evasive Bounty: [TARGET NAME] (VHRT)
missions.description:
HURSTON DYNAMICS OUTSOURCING
CONTRACT: Bounty Collection
OUTSOURCE MANAGER: I. Takao
RISK ASSESSMENT: Very High Risk Target (Armed Support)

Hurston Dynamics is seeking a contractor to complete a bounty for [TARGET NAME]. This target and the large hostile force they are traveling with have just been reported raiding [LOCATION]. 

However, if their MO holds true, [TARGET NAME] has typically remained hidden during attacks, preferring to direct their forces from afar. It is our recommendation that you focus on thinning out their allies first, and once their numbers have been significantly weakened, [TARGET NAME] will have no choice but to confront you directly. 

Payment will be released only after the bounty has been deemed complete.




** The information transmitted may contain confidential and/or privileged material. Any review, retransmission, dissemination or other use of or taking action in reliance upon this information by persons or entities other than the intended recipient is prohibited. **

missions.name: PU_TripMinesTheft_DC_Stanton_SecPed_Abandoned-Dupree
missions.title: Dangerous Take
missions.description:
I was hopin’ you’d be interested in pulling a little job for us. Got some goods over at [LOCATION] that are just right for the taking. Only problem is – and it’s a big one – the bastards running the place have the whole area rigged with proximity mines. 

You’ll need to find someway through, or if you can’t be bothered, someway to trigger the lot. Either way, just try not to blow yourself up. Then you just need to grab the stuff and take it over to [DESTINATION].

It won’t be easy to pull off, but if you do, I promise I’ll make it worth your while.

missions.name: PU_TripMinesTheft_DC_Stanton_SecPed-S4LD13
missions.title: Delicate Dealings
missions.description:
I’m really hoping you’re going to agree to do this since there doesn’t seem to be too many folks eager to take on a whole bunch of proximity mines. See, there’s a score that we’ve sourced at [LOCATION] but the physical security is proving more difficult than expected. 

If you can find a way to navigate through the mines or possibly a way to trigger them remotely, it should be relatively easy to grab the goods and make your way out of there. Drop them off at [DESTINATION] and you’ll get more than your fair cut of the credits for taking on the risk.

-Bit Zeros

missions.name: BrightSky
missions.title: Running the Gauntlet
missions.description:
The CDF has partnered with Anvil Aerospace to find the most capable operatives in the system. 

If you find one of these Platinum certifications, you can redeem the ticket at a ship kiosk at New Deal, Astro Armada or Crusader Showroom for a free F8C. 

The catch is that your identity and location has been shared with participants throughout the system. For everyone else, if you can stop the ticketholder before they get to the kiosk, you can claim the ticket for your own.

Whoever makes it will not only receive this next generation superiority fighter, but also prove that they have what it takes for the toughest CDF assignments.

Good luck.

missions.name: GMCapture
missions.title: Idris War Game
missions.description:
To test the preparedness of our response teams, we would like volunteers to simulate an assault against a CDF Idris by neutralizing and taking control of the vessel.

To be clear, the goal of the exercise is not to destroy the Idris, but for you to attempt to board the craft and maintain control of it as long as possible. Volunteers should expect to meet full resistance from the Idris' highly trained crew and are encouraged to get an updated imprint beforehand.

Coordinates will be provided upon confirming your participation.

Thanks and good luck.

missions.name: SiegeOfOrison
missions.title: End Nine Tails' Occupation at Orison
missions.description:
*FOR IMMEDIATE SYSTEM-WIDE RELEASE*

Attention, Nine Tails forces have seized control of several commercial platforms near Orison. Using an Identity Friend or Foe Inverter (IFFI), they have taken over the restricted air space surrounding the platforms and only Nine Tails affiliated ships can gain access to the area. This has severely hampered Crusader Security's initial attempts at retaking the platforms. As such, Crusader has requested that CDF forces assist in shutting down the inverter and eliminating all hostile presence. Any available CDF volunteers are encouraged to provide support.

Additional Intel:
* While the inverter is active and the airspace inaccessible, CDF has managed to gain control of a local shuttle system and route it to access Solanki Platform without the Nine Tails knowledge. Volunteers will need to head to the Crusader Industries Showroom on the Commercial Platform and get to the rooftop to find the shuttle that will travel to the occupied platforms.
* The IFFI is believed to be located in a locked storage container on a cargo barge docked at the central Admin Center.
* Access codes for the IFFI container are in the possession of the leader of the Nine Tails forces, Mendo Ren. 
* Past experience with Mendo Ren indicates that he is unlikely to show his face and risk capture. However, if all his lieutenants are neutralized, we believe he will have no choice but to take command of the forces in person and provide us the opportunity to retrieve the codes from him.
* In addition to the shuttle system, Crusader Security has informed us that there are several vehicles on the platforms available for CDF to commandeer. These vehicles will be the only way of reaching the Admin Center. NOTE - If all of the vehicles within the restricted air space are destroyed before the inverter can be shut down, then there will be no way of reaching the cargo barge and the CDF will be forced to retreat.
* The platforms are protected by Nine Tails controlled Anti-Air weapons.

Please be aware that SAIC Rowena Dulli from the Advocacy is the official attaché to the CDF and will be running the operation.

missions.name: Xenothreat_PAR
missions.title: CDF ALERT: Xenothreat Ambush - Support Needed
missions.description:
*FOR IMMEDIATE SYSTEM-WIDE RELEASE*

Attention, XenoThreat forces started to ambush Naval convoy ships transporting vital supplies while en route to Jericho station at the Pyro Gateway in the Stanton System. The Navy has requested CDF forces to help recover these supplies from the wreckage and safely deliver them to Jericho. 

The Navy has organized a community stipend to handle the distribution of payment. This will be distributed among all CDF volunteers at assigned intervals. An indicator will appear on your HUD to measure these payouts.

Please note that some of these supplies are highly volatile if not handled correctly. Use caution while transporting these materials:
* Zeta-Prolanide degrades over time until breaking down completely.
* AcryliPlex Composite becomes explosively unstable if damaged.
* Diluthermex releases a destructive energy pulse if exposed to quantum travel.
 
Additionally, while not as volatile, the supplies of DynaFlex lost during the attack are still urgently needed by the Navy to complete their repairs of the Javelin and should be a priority for recovery.    

Also, XenoThreat hostiles might still be in the area so be careful. CDF volunteers with combat experience are also urged to contribute by securing these areas from lingering XenoThreat forces.

SAIC Rowena Dulli from the Advocacy is the official attaché to the CDF and will be running the operation.

Attention, Naval forces have regrouped for a final assault on the XenoThreat outlaw pack that have been plaguing Stanton System. The Navy has officially requested for any CDF volunteers to help provide combat support in this final push to secure our system.

SAIC Rowena Dulli from the Advocacy is the official attaché to the CDF and will be running the operation.

missions.description:

The Navy has officially requested any CDF volunteers to help provide combat support in this final push to secure our system. This will include volunteers outside of those who have participated in the Overdrive Initiative.

SAIC Rowena Dulli from the Advocacy is the official attaché to the CDF and will be running the operation.

If successful, this will complete this Overdrive Initiative series and you will receive temporary access to the F7A Hornets or a free upgrade if you currently own an F7C.

missions.title: Overdrive Initiative: PRIORITY TARGETS
missions.description:
Our analysts have examined the intel seized from those XenoThreat recon teams but the data appears to be locked behind a sophisticated encryption system and requires a custom cryptokey to access.

We've managed to locate several XenoThreat lieutenants operating in the system, you are to find and engage the suspects and see if they are in possession of a cryptokey that will allows us to access the intel.

As a reminder, the military has generously donated some old F7A Hornets for CDF members who see this initiative through to the end.

We've learned that they're attempting to access their systems, so all volunteers must immediately divert to retake Kareah and clear out all XenoThreat forces.

History has proven that XenoThreat like to fight so it stands to reason that this might be an attack of some kind so we're calling on volunteers to deliver supplies to the Gateway station near the Stanton-Pyro jump point to shore up for a potential assault.

missions.name: PU_Destroy_Servers_KeypadLocked_DC_Stanton_Lobby_CryAstro
missions.title: Server Not Found
missions.description:
Hey,

Got a problem we could use your help on. One of our former new-recruits did a complete crap job on a hack and wound up leaving a digital footprint so messy that it might as well be a full confession. 

A remote deletion’s not going to be good enough so I want you to go to [LOCATION] and make sure their data servers are wiped from existence.

As if this wasn’t a big enough of a mess already, the access codes to the locked server room door are only stored physically on site. That means you’re going to have to liberate a datapad with the code on it first before you can even get close to them.

Don’t worry though. I’ll make sure the creds are worth all the hassle.  

- Bit Zeros

missions.title: Neutralize Outlaw Incursion
missions.description:
HURSTON DYNAMICS OUTSOURCING
CONTRACT: Neutralize Hostile Force
OUTSOURCE MANAGER: T. Dalik
RISK ASSESSMENT: High

Our security forces have been notified of an ongoing outlaw incursion at [LOCATION], and we are in need of an independent operator capable of clearing out the hostile actors.

missions.name: PU_BlockadeRunner
missions.title: CDF ALERT: [LOCATION] Blockade Runners Needed
missions.description:
*FOR IMMEDIATE SYSTEM-WIDE RELEASE*

A hostile fleet of ships equipped with quantum jammers have created a blockade around  [LOCATION], disabled the station's defensive turrets, and stolen a large supply of Zeta-Prolanide. In response, the CDF has received authorization to activate its volunteer force. 

Though the overall situation is dire, the theft of the Zeta-Prolanide is our priority. Without direct action, the loss of the sector's Zeta-Prolanide stores could have a devastating effects to the wider economy of the whole system. 

While local security forces are investigating the incursion, they've tracked the stolen inventory to several locations. CDF volunteers are tasked with heading to these locations, recovering the stolen Zeta-Prolanide, and transferring it back to the station before the material completely degrades and is no longer viable. Just be careful, intel suggests that larger clusters of Zeta-Prolanide have a higher outlaw presence.

Since time is of the essence, having a tractor beam to assist in moving the cargo is highly advised.

As an added incentive, volunteers will receive regular bonus payments for their combined efforts.

missions.name: PU_Collect_Covalex_Personal_Anya
missions.title: Personal Effects
missions.description:
Hi,

I'll totally understand if you don't want to help with this, but if you can it would be amazing.

See, my boyfriend passed away during the Covalex Gundo tragedy. They said I would get all of Scott's stuff back once the investigation was complete, but as far as I know, it's been done for a while now and they still haven't given any indication of when I can get his property. It's been hard enough dealing with all this, and knowing that a package is going to show up in a month or two and rip open all these wounds, it's just too much. I would prefer to deal with it now and get it over with. If you could find a way to get his personal effects (Employee ID# 104) and drop them off at [DESTINATION], I'd be very grateful.

Thanks for your help,
Anya

missions.name: PU_Collect_Covalex_Personal_Baylor
missions.title: My Dad's Stuff
missions.description:
Hi,

I'm looking for someone to head to the Covalex Gundo station near Crusader and grab some items. I know this may sound like stealing, but it's my dad's stuff. You see, he was on Gundo station when it had its accident. My mom says that we need to wait until Covalex says so, but I don't think that's fair because I miss him so much. I would like something to remember him by and I don't want to wait any longer because I might start forgetting things. I'll pay you to get box 510 for me and take to [DESTINATION] so I can have it.

Thank you very much,
Baylor Ward

missions.name: PU_Collect_Covalex_Personal_Ed
missions.title: Help Me Get My Stuff Back
missions.description:
My brother was one of those people who died when that Covalex station near Crusader blew. Even worse, he was borrowing something of mine when it happened. Now some red tape asshole is trying to tell me that I have to wait to get my stuff back. Yeah right. First you kill my brother and now you want me to be patient? The nerve of these corporate jillos. Forget that. Instead, I figured I'd hire someone to go to Gundo to get my stuff and take it to [DESTINATION] for me. I mean, what the hell are they gonna do about it? Anyway, it's what my brother would have wanted. It's gonna be the box marked 156.

- Ed

missions.name: PU_Collect_Covalex_Personal_Gloria
missions.title: A Mother's Plea
missions.description:
My son Nico was sadly among the victims of the tragic accident at Covelex's Gundo station and they still haven't returned all of his personal possessions to me. I understand that they have to do things according to regulations, but it seems unconscionable that they wouldn't make some allowances for the grieving family members. To that end, I'm seeking someone who will be able to go to the station for me. To be clear, Gundo is currently considered off limits, meaning that this would not be above board, but I feel my situation warrants special consideration. My sister says that the rate I am offering is the correct amount for retrieving the crate with Nico's belongings (#964) and bringing them to [DESTINATION], so hopefully I can find a competent individual to settle this matter quickly.

Sincerely,
Gloria Theolone

missions.name: PU_Collect_Covalex_Personal_Sam
missions.title: Looking for Closure
missions.description: They said that I could find someone here to go to Gundo for me and grab a crate that belonged to my wife. If the name didn't ring a bell, that's the station where they had that big accident. My wife worked for Covalex and I know it's not really going to make losing her any easier, but I really just want Claudia's stuff back. I think about her photo collection or the necklace I gave her just sitting there in that cold dead station in some box marked 249 and it's not right. She deserves better. So how about it? You willing to go to Gundo and haul her crate back to [DESTINATION]?

missions.name: PU_Collect_Covalex_Personal_Thrace
missions.title: Unexpected Inheritance
missions.description:
Hey,

So this is a little awkward for me to talk about, but it turns out that one of the people who passed away on that Covalex station disaster, Kyomi Santos, actually bequeathed me something in her will. I was surprised to hear it, but apparantly I'm now the proud owner of everything stored in box #173. The people at Covalex say I'll be able to get it when the station opens back up but ... this is the awkward part ... I kind of really need it right now. Normally I'd just wait, but I'm trying to start my own business (I make cakes in the shape of people's homeworlds) and the credits I get from selling it will really be a huge help. I've got a little bit stashed away now that I can use to pay for someone to deliver it from Gundo to [DESTINATION] for me. I know the whole things a little bit irregular, but if there was any other way I wouldn't be asking.

Thanks for the help,
Thrace

missions.name: PU_HijackedShip_890
missions.title: URGENT: Boarding Action In Progress
missions.description:
An executive client just informed us that their 890 Jump had been intercepted at [LOCATION] and boarded by outlaws. They would prefer to have this handled privately owing to the sensitive nature of proprietary data that's being stored aboard. 

Your first priority will be to clear all outlaws as quickly as possible so that a recovery team can be dispatched to return the ship to the owner. The longer the outlaws have control of the vessel, the higher the chance it will be lost. I recommend you acquire a team for this outing to expedite matters. 

Note that thanks to a small contingent of Security Personnel who stayed aboard, all surviving members of the crew were able to flee in an escape craft. The current status of the remaining security is unknown, but just in case, keep an eye out for friendlies when you engage the hostiles.

Secondly, if at all possible, the client is *very* interested in preventing the theft of the aforementioned data. If you are able to stop the theft of their confidential data stores before they are transmitted, a generous bonus will be issued.

Needless to say, this is a client I would very much like to keep happy. 

Braden Corchado
Logistics Officer - Stanton Branch
Northrock Service Group

missions.name: PU_InvestigateDestroyship
missions.title: Seize the Data
missions.description:
Been hunting down a particular parcel of data and right when I get a break the ship gets attacked by this converted Nine Tails Reclaimer called the Black Kite. I tried to hack into the servers on the Black Kite to see if they copied the data, but couldn't find a way to remotely get past their encryption protocols without the physical key.

That's where you come in. I need someone to breach their ship, get a hold of their decryption key, and decrypt the server so I can remotely pull down what I need.

You're smart enough to know who we're dealing with here, so plan accordingly. Since it's gonna ruffle some powerful feathers, let's not leave anything to chance. Destroy the Black Kite when you're done to cover both our asses.

missions.name: PU_Jumptown2_Child_Illegal
missions.title: Ripe for the Taking
missions.description:
Got some good news for you. As we speak, there’s an automated facility that is churning out package after package of primo product that’s pretty much ripe for the taking.

All you have to do is swoop down there, deal with a thug or two, grab whatever you can, and sell it for a huge profit. Shouldn’t be a problem at all. And there are plenty of people around who would pay good creds to take product like that off your hands.

Speaking of credits, I’m not gonna just give out the coordinates of this facility out of the kindness of my heart. I think it’s only fair to ask a finder’s fee for info this good.

I wouldn’t wait too long. Not sure how long the site will be left running.

-Ruto

missions.title: Confiscate Contraband
missions.description:
Crusader Security has learned that an illegal production facility at [LOCATION] is currently being used to manufacture contraband. 

We are seeking a contractor to secure the site, confiscate any contraband, and deliver it to us at [DESTINATION]. The administrative commodity terminal will allow you to submit the contraband into our evidence hold and collect your payment.

Now, this is an automated facility so it’s not clear how long they’ll be manufacturing for, or even how many people may be on site. To be safe, I would go in expecting to meet heavy resistance.

Your total compensation will be based on how packages are safely delivered into evidence.

CONTRACT AUTHORIZED BY:
Liaison Officer Vanzant
ID# 712L921P

HURSTON DYNAMICS
OUTSOURCING DEPARTMENT

CONTRACT: Confiscate Contraband
CONTRACTOR AFFILIATION: Independent
OUTSOURCE MANAGER: T. Odington
RISK ASSESSMENT: High
RUSH CONTRACT: No

Hurston Security has learned of an active, illegal automated production facility at [LOCATION] and is seeking a contractor to secure the site and confiscate as many packages of contraband as possible for delivery to a Hurston Security facility [DESTINATION] for immediate disposal. Transfer of the contraband and attribution of your reward payment should be done through the administrative commodity terminal there.

You are authorized to use any force necessary to complete your objective. Payment will be based on the amount of contraband secured. 




** The information transmitted may contain confidential and/or privileged material. Any review, retransmission, dissemination, or other use of or taking action in reliance upon this information by persons or entities other than the intended recipient is prohibited. **

Lt. Aaron Riegert

BlacJac Security, "Protection Provided"

missions.description:
It is not often in life that we get another chance to make a first impression, but I am going to provide to you with just that.

To say I was disappointed in how things last transpired on your last assassination attempt would be a severe understatement. However, here is your chance to prove yourself capable of more.

missions.name: PU_Assassination_PVE_Vaughn_Intro
missions.title: A Chance to Impress
missions.description:
Firstly, allow me to introduce myself. To put it rather dramatically, I deal in lives. 

People hire me when some soul needs to be extinguished, and I in return employ the perfect person to serve as the extinguishant. This provides security to all parties involved as none know the identity of the other. An ideal situation as far as these things go.

I was recently made aware that you may possess skills that would make you of service to me and decided that it would be worthwhile to pursue the validity of this claim. 
 
If you have any interest in forging a working relationship, I will need a demonstration of said skills. 

Seek out and discreetly kill [TARGET NAME] over at [LOCATION].

Do so successfully and you will be rewarded. Not only that, but you will have proven yourself worthy of further consideration.

Sincerely,

missions.name: PU_Assassination_SyncedAssassination_Eckhart_Easy
missions.title: Double Tap
missions.description:
A price has been set on the heads of [TARGET NAME] and [TARGET NAME2]. 

While having to hit two targets isn't that weird, the client wants to send a very specific message, so they need to targets hit at the exact same moment. The extra credits should make up for the hassle.

And unfortunately since the pair aren't traveling together, it goes without saying that to pull it off you're gonna need some help. Make sure you bring people you trust can handle more than one ships since the targets are known to travel with backup.

missions.name: PU_Assassination_SyncedAssassination_Eckhart_Hard
missions.title: Two In The Head
missions.description:
Contract's for two targets that need to be taken out at the same time. 

Guess the client is worried that if they aren't eliminated together, one of them will go dark and try to get some revenge.

They go by [TARGET NAME] and [TARGET NAME2].

Find yourself a team, divide and conquer.

And make sure whoever it is has got skills, because these two have a reputation for holding their own in a fight and they for sure won't be alone. Be ready for them to give you some trouble.

missions.name: PU_Assassination_SyncedAssassination_Eckhart_Intro
missions.title: Coordinated Takedown
missions.description:
Interesting assignment came my way. I need two separate targets taken out: [TARGET NAME] and [TARGET NAME2] 

Problem is, either one gets word about the other being hit, they’ll go to ground. Can’t risk losing either of them. 

It’ll take considerable coordination, but I want you to hit them both at the same exact time.  

And since you can’t be in two places at once, you’ll need to find someone you can trust to help on this.

Thankfully, my intel says that both the targets should be traveling alone. That should help make things a bit easier on you.

missions.name: PU_Assassination_SyncedAssassination_Eckhart_Medium
missions.title: Double Elimination
missions.description:
Got a contract to take out two up and comers who've been stirring up trouble. It has to be clean, both done at the same time, or else they might cause even more trouble.  Long story short, you'll need some help on this one.

Both [TARGET NAME] and [TARGET NAME2] know how to handle themselves, and the people they fly with aren't no joke either. You can expect each of them to be guarded by a few ships.

missions.name: PU_Assassination_SyncedAssassination_Eckhart_Super
missions.title: Divide and Conquer
missions.description:
Normally, the pair of [TARGET NAME] and [TARGET NAME2] would be too much to take on together. They both are about as good as it gets when it comes to dogfighting and the crew they fly with are almost as good.

But recently they split - not sure why - and are flying separate for the moment.  Someone thinks this may be the best chance to take them out. 

Gather some personnel you can trust and plan a simultaneous raid against both targets. It's too dangerous to risk one of them living after such a direct move against them.

missions.name: PU_Assassination_SyncedAssassination_Eckhart_VEasy
missions.title: One-Two Combo
missions.description:
Have another pair that need to be eliminated:
[TARGET NAME] and [TARGET NAME2]

They've been in the wind for a few days now, but just popped up. If we don't get them now, I'm not sure we will get another chance.  You need to enlist a partner to make sure both targets are hit at the same time.

As far as them putting up resistance, [TARGET NAME] is known to bring along a friend to watch their back, and I suspect [TARGET NAME2] will do likewise.

missions.name: PU_Assassination_SyncedAssassination_Eckhart_VHard
missions.title: Deadly Combination
missions.description:
[TARGET NAME] and [TARGET NAME2].

Two serious operators who've recently decided to make a move against their boss. Each of the pair are traveling with a small, highly trained armada and cutting deep into territory that doesn't belong to them.

You, and whoever you recruit to help, are going to take them out and it has to be both at the same time so they can't regroup.

missions.name: PU_Assassination_SyncedAssassination_Ruto_Easy
missions.title: together forever
missions.description:
Here's the deal. [TARGET NAME] and [TARGET NAME2] need to die at the same time. Unfortunately, they aren't gonna be in the same place.

A double hit can sound complicated, but if you hire some additional guns it shouldn't be all that hard to do two hits simultaneously.

Make sure you find folks who have skills as I have it on good authority that each'll be flying with some escorts for "protection."

missions.name: PU_Assassination_SyncedAssassination_Ruto_Hard
missions.title: twice the headache
missions.description:
Have another pair that needs simultaneous deathing. Seems to be getting more and more popular as a murder option. 

This time it's [TARGET NAME] and [TARGET NAME2]. Both are supposed to be pretty skilled operators and they won't be flying alone. 

I'd make sure whoever you get to help you on this one can handle a fight.

missions.name: PU_Assassination_SyncedAssassination_Ruto_Intro
missions.title: simultaneous release
missions.description:
Guess what [TARGET NAME] and [TARGET NAME2] have in common? 

You're gonna kill 'em both!

Difficult part is that I need you to kill them at the same time so that one doesn't have a chance to escape, or worse, kill the person trying to kill them. 

So put together a team to track one target while you handle the other. Divide and conquer!

And despite the fact they made a mess big enough to get themselves killed, my understanding is that they are relative lightweights. Don't expect you to meet too much resistance.

missions.name: PU_Assassination_SyncedAssassination_Ruto_Medium
missions.title: friends to the end
missions.description:
I really hope that you're not buddies with [TARGET NAME] or [TARGET NAME2] because I need you to ghost the pair of them... at the same time...

Of course they wouldn't make this easy on us and travel in the same ship or something obvious like that. No. You're going to have to put together a crew so that you can down both targets simultaneously. 

As soon as one of them is dead, be ready to drop the other one too. Can't risk either of them getting away.

And I figure I should mention that not only are both pretty good pilots, but that they'll be traveling with backup too. Nothing you can't handle I'm sure.

missions.name: PU_Assassination_SyncedAssassination_Ruto_Super
missions.title: double trouble
missions.description:
If you had asked me, I would've said [TARGET NAME] and [TARGET NAME2] would have wound up eventually killing each other. But instead you're going to get the honor of killing them both at the same time.

You're going to have to work for it, though.

Each one is trouble. Serious records, highly trained, and too smart to fly without backup.

Gather the best crew you can on this one. You'll need it. And don't be stingy. You can't spend credits if you're dead.

missions.name: PU_Assassination_SyncedAssassination_Ruto_VEasy
missions.title: death do us part
missions.description:
It's pretty touching when you run across a pair that's willing to die for one another. Stupid but touching.

[TARGET NAME] and [TARGET NAME2] chose to stand by each other and now its gone and got them dead.

Find a friend of your own and hunt each of these two down. Make sure you kill them at the same time. Call it poetic justice.

They should die pretty easy. Maybe they'll have a ship or two with them but I don't think it'll be anything to worry about.

missions.name: PU_Assassination_SyncedAssassination_Ruto_VHard
missions.title: two for the price of two
missions.description:
[TARGET NAME] and [TARGET NAME2]. I think they may be related? Or dating? Doesn't really matter, someone wants them killed. 

I've arranged it so that you can hit them when they're not flying together. Safer for you this way. They are both serious business and fly with equally serious backup.

Make sure you and your crew time your attacks. I don't want one of them left alive or it's going to be a real headache.

missions.title: Eliminate XenoThreat Idris
missions.description:
Hey, 

The rumors are true. XenoThreat has deployed an Idris to stalk and attack Citizens for Prosperity operations in a dramatic escalation of their hostility towards us. We just received word the ship, under the command of [TARGET NAME], is advancing toward [LOCATION]. We can’t get our own forces there fast enough to fight them, and are in desperate need of help. 

We’re looking to hire someone brave enough to take it to these bastards. It’s not enough to scare them away, we need to guarantee that it can’t come after us again. 

Not sure if you’ve faced down an Idris before, but it’s a tall task for someone to take on alone. I’d highly recommend recruiting others to the cause.   

Best,

Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity

missions.name: PU_Bounty_PVE_Pyro_HeadHunters_Generic_Easy
missions.title: Deadbeat
missions.description:
The Headhunters recently loaned credits to [TARGET NAME] under some clear conditions. Specifically, pay us back or we’ll kill you. Wild to think that wasn’t enough of an incentive, but here we are past the payment deadline. Now as much as we like [TARGET NAME], I need you to make good on our promise.

[TARGET NAME] was last seen at [LOCATION]. Track ‘em down, ghost ‘em, and get paid. It’s as simple as that. 

Stows out.

missions.name: PU_Bounty_PVE_Pyro_HeadHunters_Generic_Hard
missions.title: Collection Notice
missions.description:
[TARGET NAME] borrowed a bunch of creds from the Headhunters and thought the smart move was to try and hide instead of paying us back, so I need someone to make an example of [TARGET NAME].

They were just spotted at [LOCATION], so I’d recommend heading there now before the trail goes cold. [TARGET NAME] is a paranoid sort, so don’t be surprised if they’re not alone. Handle it however you want as long as [TARGET NAME] is dust when you’re done.   

Stows out.

missions.name: PU_Bounty_PVE_Pyro_HeadHunters_Generic_Medium
missions.title: Past Due
missions.description:
Time is up for [TARGET NAME]. The skav is way past due on paying back the Headhunters, so I need you to punch them out. 

Kill ‘em, not hit ‘em, just in case that’s unclear. 

Someone recently spotted [TARGET NAME] around [LOCATION], so head there and take ‘em out.  

Full disclosure, we’ve gotten reports they used some of our creds to hire extra protection. Prepare accordingly. 

Stows out.

missions.name: PU_Bounty_PVE_Pyro_HeadHunters_vs_XenoThreat
missions.title: [CONTRACTOR]
missions.description: [CONTRACTOR]

missions.name: PU_Bounty_PVE_Pyro_HeadHunters_vs_XenoThreat_Easy
missions.title: Preemptive Strike
missions.description:
Headhunters got word there’s a XenoThreat op in the works that's targeting one of our crews. We don’t have precise details about the plan but we know that [TARGET NAME] is organizing it. Instead of sitting back and waiting for something to happen, we’ve decided to be proactive. 

[TARGET NAME] was just spotted with others around [LOCATION]. We can’t mobilize anyone fast enough to get there. I want you to rush there and deliver a preemptive strike.   

Stows out.

missions.name: PU_Bounty_PVE_Pyro_HeadHunters_vs_XenoThreat_Hard
missions.title: Exact Justice
missions.description:
[TARGET NAME] was recently revealed to be a mole for XenoThreat. It all makes sense now because the skav was a major asshole. Unfortunately, they split before we could handle it ourselves. 

Based on all they learned about our ops, we need ‘em taken out pronto. They see one of us coming and they’ll just run again, but I figured someone like you has a better chance of getting close enough for a killshot. 

We just got word [TARGET NAME] was hanging around [LOCATION]. Looks like there’s other ships around protecting ‘em too. Think you got the skill to rid the ‘verse of a traitorous bastard and their bastard friends?  

Stows out.

missions.name: PU_Bounty_PVE_Pyro_HeadHunters_vs_XenoThreat_Medium
missions.title: Payback
missions.description:
XenoThreat recently hit a Headhunters' stronghold. I’ll spare you the details, but they did some truly heinous shit to our crew. We’ve identified the leader of the op as [TARGET NAME] and are looking for a little payback. We don’t care what you do to get the job done. Only that [TARGET NAME] is dead. 

A source just told us that you can track down this XenoThreat scum over at [LOCATION]. This sicko’s a pro and never travels alone, so don’t expect taking them out to be a walk in the park.  

Stows out.

missions.name: PU_Bounty_PVE_Pyro_RoughAndReady_Cargo_Easy
missions.title: Double Dealing
missions.description:
Rough & Ready recently provided fueling services for a hauler named [TARGET NAME], who agreed to deliver their next load of supplies to us as compensation. Well, we just found out that the lying skag sold their latest shipment to a rival gang instead. 

We’re looking for someone to track down and eliminate [TARGET NAME] for the double cross. 

An old friend of mine just spotted the skag at [LOCATION]. Looks like they're loaded with more cargo that’s not coming our way, and traveling with an escort. We’re only paying you to take out the ship, so anything you find aboard is yours to keep.

- Smokey

missions.name: PU_Bounty_PVE_Pyro_RoughAndReady_Cargo_Hard
missions.title: Trigger A Trap
missions.description:
Some asshole going by the name [TARGET NAME] has been running a scheme where their cargo ship requests refueling services only to ambush our ships when they get there. Even loaded the damn thing up with real cargo to make sure it passes scans. We’ve spread the word so nobody in Rough & Ready will fall for the trap again, but I want this skag punished. 

I think [TARGET NAME] knows a lot of our people on sight, so I’m guessing it’ll be better to pay you to take care of it. Heard that they were spotted around [LOCATION]. Head there now and take care of that cargo ship and anyone protecting it once and for all. 

- Smokey

missions.name: PU_Bounty_PVE_Pyro_RoughAndReady_Cargo_Medium
missions.title: Failed Delivery
missions.description:
My associates and I brokered a deal with a hauler named [TARGET NAME] to deliver supplies to us. Funny thing is the shipment never showed up. They claimed pirates raided their ship and took our supplies, but it turns out that story’s 100% ranta dung.

Lying to back out of our deal can’t go unanswered and you’re going to make that message abundantly clear. [TARGET NAME] was recently seen with an escort at [LOCATION]. As long as you kill [TARGET NAME], we don’t care what happens to the cargo they’re hauling. 

- Smokey

missions.name: PU_Bounty_PVE_Pyro_RoughAndReady_Generic
missions.title: [CONTRACTOR]
missions.description: [CONTRACTOR]

missions.name: PU_Bounty_PVE_Pyro_RoughAndReady_Generic_Easy
missions.title: Strike Saboteur
missions.description:
Interested in doing a little hunting? 

[TARGET NAME] sabotaged one of our fuel shipments and cost us a ton of creds, so I’m looking for someone to make ‘em pay for what they did. Just got word [TARGET NAME] was spotted at [LOCATION]. If you head there now, there’s a good chance you can pick up their trail and take ‘em out for good. 

[TARGET NAME] didn’t work alone, so don’t be surprised if they’re traveling with extra protection.

- Smokey

missions.name: PU_Bounty_PVE_Pyro_RoughAndReady_Generic_Hard
missions.title: Parting Gift
missions.description:
I have a delicate situation that needs handling. After years of being a loyal member of Rough & Ready, [TARGET NAME] defected from the gang and is out there shopping secrets to our rivals. We need [TARGET NAME] ghosted immediately. 

With stuff like this, I’ve found it’s always better to pay someone unassociated with us to do the deed. Scans picked up [TARGET NAME] near [LOCATION] not too long ago. We’ll pay you well to head there now and take care ‘em for us. 

[TARGET NAME] isn’t an idiot and knows we’ll be coming after ‘em. Be prepared for a helluva fight and don’t expect ‘em to be alone.

- Smokey

missions.name: PU_Bounty_PVE_Pyro_RoughAndReady_Generic_Medium
missions.title: Long Overdue
missions.description:
Rough & Ready have been in business with [TARGET NAME] for years but that relationship has taken a turn for the worse. For a while, we were supplying them with fuel on credit but when it came time to collect the coward went into hiding. If [TARGET NAME] can’t pay with creds, guess they’re gonna pay with their life.

An associate just clocked [TARGET NAME] at [LOCATION]. I’d love for you to head there now to make the stingy bastard pay.

By the way, it looks like [TARGET NAME] isn’t traveling alone, so I’d make sure you’re fully stocked before going after ‘em. 

- Smokey

As a Clips level member of the Headhunters gang, [TARGET NAME] has led operations that have targeted XenoThreat operatives, missions, and infrastructure. For these transgressions, XenoThreat will pay anyone who successfully tracks down and assassinates [TARGET NAME].  

LOCATION UPDATE: [TARGET NAME] was seen near [LOCATION] not too long ago.  If you decide to accept this contract, you should head to the coordinates immediately. [TARGET NAME] knows we’re looking for ‘em and has been traveling with an escort recently. Don’t be surprised if they’re not alone.

Comm. Spec. Engler

missions.name: PU_Bounty_PVE_Pyro_XenoThreat_vs_HeadHunters_Hard
missions.title: Track Down Spy
missions.description:
XenoThreat has placed a kill order on the head of [TARGET NAME]. As a member of the Headhunters gang, [TARGET NAME] hacked into XenoThreat systems to steal information on our operations and personnel. The harm done can only be rectified by ensuring [TARGET NAME] can never do something like this again. That’s why XenoThreat will pay anyone who can track down and assassinate [TARGET NAME].     

LOCATION UPDATE: Recent scans identified [TARGET NAME] traveling with other ships near [LOCATION]. 

Comm. Spec. Engler

missions.name: PU_Bounty_PVE_Pyro_XenoThreat_vs_HeadHunters_Medium
missions.title: Track Down Traitor
missions.description:
XenoThreat has placed a kill order on [TARGET NAME]. A known member of the Headhunters gang, [TARGET NAME] has betrayed Humankind by being a known alien ally who associates with them in both a personal and business capacity. XenoThreat wants these traitorous associations stopped immediately before they bring more alien influence to Pyro. We’ll pay anyone who successfully tracks down and assassinates [TARGET NAME] for these crimes against Humanity.  

LOCATION UPDATE: [TARGET NAME] was recently spotted with an escort at [LOCATION]. 

Comm. Spec. Engler

missions.description:
POSTING: Security / Mercenary 
LOCATION: [LAGRANGE LOCATION]
WORK EXPERIENCE: Combat Pilot (Military Experience a Plus)
TERMS*: 
It was recently discovered that a Shubin mining claim has been illegally poached by a rogue miner. While the miner themselves seems to no longer be stealing ore from the site, they did leave behind an orbital sentry which is preventing us from reclaiming it thanks to its offensive capabilities.

We are looking for a mercenary willing to travel to [LOCATION] hunt down the sentry and destroy it in preparation for Shubin repossession of the site.




*Shubin Interstellar is an equal opportunity contractor. By accepting this contract you are assuming any and all risks associated with the work outlined herein and in no way can Shubin Interstellar be held accountable for any damages accrued during the duration of the contract.

missions.name: PU_RemoveClaimJumpers_Pyro_HeadHunters_Easy
missions.title: Eliminate Eavesdroppers
missions.description:
Some numbskull is trying to dig up dirt on the Headhunters. Some orbital sentries were dropped at [LOCATION] to spy on us. We’ve also spotted a ship checking on them. Simple proposition for you. Go wipe out the sentries there and we’ll pay you for it. That sound like something you’d be into?

As for the ship, you can do whatever you want with it, but if it spots you, don’t be surprised if it tries to go get some back up. That’s just how these things go.

Stows out.

missions.name: PU_RemoveClaimJumpers_Pyro_HeadHunters_Hard
missions.title: Exterminate Eavesdroppers
missions.description:
Some idiots think they can blatantly spy on the Headhunters and get away with it. They’ve set up several orbital sentries at [LOCATION] and have a few ships patrolling the area. We don’t know who’s behind it but we honestly don’t care. We just need it gone. 

Let us know if you feel like putting some real brash bastards in their place. We’ll pay you well and deliver the creds the second the job is done. 

Keep in mind that it’s really only the sentries we care about. The ships they got patrolling are only a concern if they get in your way or if they try to call in some friends to stop you. 
 
Stows out.

missions.name: PU_RemoveClaimJumpers_Pyro_HeadHunters_Medium
missions.title: Eradicate Eavesdroppers
missions.description:
Headhunters are looking for a merc to do a little clean up for us. Found out that someone’s trying to spy on us over at [LOCATION]. Can’t let that stand. We need a skilled operator to take care of the orbital sentries they dropped there, and if needed, deal with any of their ships that get in your way. Seems like a decently run op, so hitting it might not be easy but it sure should be fun. 

Let us know if you’re the right one for the gig. Creds will be transferred once our scans show it’s gone. 

Stows out.

missions.name: PU_RemoveClaimJumpers_Pyro_RoughAndReady
missions.title: [CONTRACTOR]
missions.description: [CONTRACTOR]

missions.name: PU_RemoveClaimJumpers_Pyro_RoughAndReady_Intro
missions.title: Stop Spying Op
missions.description:
My associates and I have found ourselves in a little predicament and could use some help. There’s an orbital sentry at [LOCATION] that’s spying on us. We don’t know who put it there, but it sure as hell can’t stay. 

Thing is we’re business minded folks first and foremost and worry that if we blow it up ourselves it’ll start shit. That’s why it’s better if someone like you does it. Should be a quick and easy gig for someone interested in earning some creds.   

- Smokey

missions.name: PU_RemoveClaimJumpers_Pyro_RoughAndReady_Easy
missions.title: Silence Spying Op
missions.description:
The Rough & Ready crew is looking for someone to handle a delicate situation. We’ve discovered a ship and orbital sentries at [LOCATION] spyin’ on us. We’re in a bit of a bind because we don’t want to start a larger fight with whoever’s behind this. That’s why we’re looking for some hired help who can quickly and discreetly take care of it for us. Interested?

Last thing, once you’re out there, make sure to keep an eye on that ship. Bet as soon as you start blowin’ up their sentries they’re gonna try to bring in some help to stop you.
 
- Smokey

missions.name: PU_RemoveClaimJumpers_Pyro_RoughAndReady_Hard
missions.title: Stomp Spying Op
missions.description:
The Rough & Ready crew is looking for an independent merc interested in something heavy. We’ve been keeping an eye on a developing situation at [LOCATION] where ships are guarding several orbital sentries spying on our operations.      

Now, I might’ve been born at night, but it wasn’t last night. Considering the blatant way they’re set up, whoever’s responsible had to know we’d eventually discover it. Almost feels like they’re baiting R&R into attacking it, and I don’t want us falling for it. 

Instead, you’re gonna do it for us and get paid a damn good amount of creds for your effort. The ships stationed there will be less suspicious of an unaffiliated ship approaching and make it harder to pin the attack on us. 

Just be sure to plan accordingly before heading in. Maybe bring your own reinforcements in case any of their ships escape and call in some of their own.     

- Smokey

missions.name: PU_RemoveClaimJumpers_Pyro_RoughAndReady_Medium
missions.title: Squash Spying Op
missions.description:
Recently made an interesting discovery that someone set up a handful of orbital sentries at [LOCATION]. Guess they’re trying to grab some info about our operations there. They even have a few ships guarding to make sure nothing happens to them. 

Of course, we want these bastards gone, but I’m worried that getting rid of it ourselves would be bad for business. That’s why we’re looking for a little ‘plausible deniability’. Someone from outside of R&R to eliminate the problem, so whoever is behind it can’t directly tie the attack back to us. I know this won’t be a walk in the park, especially with those guards lurking. Who knows how many reinforcements they have at the ready? But if you manage to get it done, we’re prepared to see you paid right. 

Think you’ve got the skills to pull this off? 

- Smokey

missions.name: PU_RemoveClaimJumpers_Pyro_XenoThreat
missions.title: [CONTRACTOR]
missions.description: [CONTRACTOR]

missions.name: PU_RemoveClaimJumpers_Pyro_XenoThreat_Intro
missions.title: Surveillance Termination
missions.description:
It seems our struggle to free Humanity has got the government lapdogs back on Earth feeling nervous. Recent scans discovered an orbital sentry at [LOCATION] that we believe is part of an UEE espionage campaign. Good credits says they’re handing the data direct to the slinks themselves. 

Only one sentry has been detected so far, but who knows how big the operation will grow if it’s not taken off-line. Shouldn’t be too much trouble for a skilled merc. If that sounds like you, payment will be sent promptly once the sentry is destroyed. Plus, XenoThreat will remember that you’re someone willing to fight for what’s right.

Comm. Spec. Engler

missions.name: PU_RemoveClaimJumpers_Pyro_XenoThreat_Easy
missions.title: Silence Sentries
missions.description:
Our resistance movement is growing by the day, but that comes with some unwanted attention.  Recent scans discovered orbital sentries at [LOCATION] and a ship running a patrol pattern. We believe this is part of an espionage campaign targeting XenoThreat, most likely funded by the UEE. 

We’re looking for an experienced merc willing to destroy the sentries ASAP.  Since they already have eyes and ears on us, sending in someone from outside the org would draw less attention. If you take the gig, you’ll be paid promptly once the sentries are destroyed.
 
Now, while the patrol ship isn’t the main target, we suspect that if it escapes it might have reinforcements in reserve. Might be smart to deal with it promptly. 

If you decide to help us, XenoThreat will remember you’re someone willing to fight for what’s right.

Comm. Spec. Engler

missions.name: PU_RemoveClaimJumpers_Pyro_XenoThreat_Hard
missions.title: Annihilate Sentries
missions.description:
Recent scans discovered several orbital sentries and ships at [LOCATION]. We believe they’re part of an espionage campaign targeting XenoThreat, in response to our recent actions in the Stanton system. Seems XenoThreat must be doing something right, if they’re out here spying like this.

We’re looking for an experienced and highly-skilled merc willing to eliminate this operation. If you don’t want Pyro to become a surveillance system, then this is your chance to stop it. The sentries probably won’t be too big of an issue, but pay mind to the patrol ships. If they manage to break away, you’ll have a whole lot more trouble breathing down your neck. 

You’ll have our gratitude and a sizable payment once the job is done. 

Comm. Spec. Engler

missions.name: PU_RemoveClaimJumpers_Pyro_XenoThreat_Medium
missions.title: Eradicate Sentries
missions.description:
Do you value Humanity’s freedom? If so, I’m offering you a chance to prove it. Recent scans discovered orbital sentries and patrolling ships at [LOCATION]. We believe they’re part of a UEE espionage campaign targeting XenoThreat. It’s important that we stop their intelligence gathering before we launch our next mission.

We’re looking for an experienced merc willing to eliminate these forces immediately. The sentries are the priority, but the ships might prove a bigger issue if they’re allowed to escape. You’ll have to evaluate the situation more closely once you’re on site. 

We could take care of it ourselves, but want to send in a contractor so the scum behind it don’t know who hit them. Payment will be sent promptly upon completion. Plus, the satisfaction of knowing you’re helping a good cause.

Comm. Spec. Engler

POSTING: Security / Mercenary 
LOCATION: [LAGRANGE LOCATION]
WORK EXPERIENCE: Combat Pilot (Military Experience a Plus)
TERMS*: 
We just received word that a Shubin contractor was chased off one of our claims by outlaws who are operating there illegally. Further complicating matters, they have set up a few orbital sentries to protect themselves while they mine. 

Our hope is to contract with a mercenary who can search for and destroy the sentries at [LOCATION]. If you do encounter an illegal miner at the site, be mindful that it is common practice for these types to contact reinforcements for assistance. It might be better to neutralize them as quickly as possible before they can do so. 




*Shubin Interstellar is an equal opportunity contractor. By accepting this contract you are assuming any and all risks associated with the work outlined herein and in no way can Shubin Interstellar be held accountable for any damages accrued during the duration of the contract.

missions.name: PU_RemoveClaimJumpers_Hard
missions.title: Oust Claimjumpers
missions.description:
POSTING: Security / Mercenary 
LOCATION: [LAGRANGE LOCATION]
WORK EXPERIENCE: Combat Pilot (Military Experience a Plus)
TERMS*: 
A local Stanton independent mining team was working [LOCATION] as Shubin Interstellar contractors when a hostile force attacked and took over the site. We believe that the perpetrators are still at the claim using the equipment left behind to harvest the valuable ore there for themselves.

Among the equipment lost were a handful of orbital sentries that had unfortunately not yet been fully deployed at the time of the attack. Long range scans of the claim have led us to conclude that the outlaws have activated the orbital sentries and are using them to protect their illegal operations.

To reclaim the site, we are seeking contractors to go to [LOCATION], destroy the orbital sentries, and clear the site of hostile miners. Efficiency is strongly recommended as there is a high risk they will call for reinforcements once they discover they’re being evicted. 




*Shubin Interstellar is an equal opportunity contractor. By accepting this contract you are assuming any and all risks associated with the work outlined herein and in no way can Shubin Interstellar be held accountable for any damages accrued during the duration of the contract.

missions.name: PU_RemoveClaimJumpers_Medium
missions.title: Expel Claimjumpers
missions.description:
POSTING: Security / Mercenary 
LOCATION: [LAGRANGE LOCATION]
WORK EXPERIENCE: Combat Pilot (Military Experience a Plus)
TERMS*: 
A recently acquired Shubin Interstellar mining claim awaiting processing was discovered to have been jumped by a rogue mining outfit who are actively stealing ore from the site.  While local authorities have been notified, there is concern that valuable assets may be harvested before an official investigation can be launched.

Therefore, as is our right as claim holders, we wish to secure a mercenary force to go to [LOCATION] and destroy the several orbital sentries that are protecting this illegal operation. Caution is advised as there may still be a few illegal miners at the location along with any reinforcements they muster.

missions.name: PU_NTLockdown_Delivery
missions.title: Illegal Blockade – Medical Supplies Needed
missions.description:
The illegal quantum blockade of [LOCATION] has interrupted normal trade routes and essentials are in short supply. 

Crusader Security is looking for traders and haulers to provide much needed medical supplies to the station. 

Prices offered by the station administration will be adjusted to reflect the situation with the Nine Tails, and in addition, Crusader will provide a hazard bonus upon successful transfer of the medical supplies because of the increased risk. 

Thank you in advance for your support during these difficult times.

CONTRACT AUTHORIZED BY:
Director Sasha Rust
ID# 122L964G

missions.name: PU_NTLockdown_FleetDestroy
missions.title: Illegal Blockade - Neutralizing Nine Tails Fleet
missions.description:
Crusader Security has confirmed the location of the outlaw Nine Tails fleet responsible and is mobilizing now to end the quantum blockade of [LOCATION].

We are again seeking trained security professionals to join with our emergency response efforts and assist in neutralizing this dangerous threat.

Before accepting, please be aware that the Nine Tails are fully expected to offer considerable resistance and that until the blockade is ended, quantum travel will not be possible in the sector.

CONTRACT AUTHORIZED BY:
Director Sasha Rust
ID# 122L964G

missions.name: PU_NTLockdown_FleetDestroy_Antagonist
missions.title: Aid The Blockade
missions.description:
Now that Crusader’s found their fleet, it seems the Nine Tails finally realized just how useful a bit of extra help can be.

Long story short, they’re looking for some hired muscle to keep Crusader at bay. You’ll and everyone else who volunteers get a payout for every security ship you take down. 

And on top of that, if all of you keep Crusader occupied long enough for the Nine Tails to finish up whatever the hell it is that they’re up to with this quantum blockade, you’ll get a big fat bonus.

missions.name: PU_NTLockdown_FleetFind
missions.title: Illegal Blockade - Seeking Nine Tails Fleet Responsible
missions.description:
Crusader Security has learned that the criminal organization known as the Nine Tails have set an illegal blockade around [LOCATION] and stopped all incoming and outgoing quantum traffic in the sector.

The outlaw fleet must be located, and the blockade terminated.

We are urgently requesting any trained security professionals in the system to join Crusader Security forces and protect our scanning ships as they seek out the location of the Nine Tails fleet causing this blockade.

Please bear in mind that with quantum travel disabled and numerous hostiles in the area, this should be considered a high-risk operation. Proper equipment and a full tank of fuel is strongly recommended for all pilots joining this emergency response effort. 

CONTRACT AUTHORIZED BY:
Director Sasha Rust
ID# 122L964G

missions.name: PU_NTLockdown_FleetFind_Antagonist
missions.title: Away From Prying Eyes
missions.description:
I told the Nine Tails that blocking quantum travel to hold a whole area hostage was gonna attract the wrong kind of attention, but do they listen to me? No. Now Crusader’s got dozens of scanning ships out there poking their noses into things I’d rather stay hidden. 

That’s why I'm trying to hire as many people as I can to help me out. I wanna pay you for each Crusader scanning ship you take out. 

In fact, I’ll even up your rate per-ship if all of you hit a certain number of kills. Call it a performance incentive.

And if you're really feeling like an overachiever, take out any fools brave enough to try running cargo to the blockaded station. I've got some suppliers who'll be appreciative of the extra demand.

missions.name: PU_PVP_Bounty_Stanton_NorthRock_General_Intro
missions.title: Pro Tem Suspect Apprehension
missions.description:
Hi,

Hope you don't mind, but I was made aware of your Bounty Hunters Guild status and wanted to reach out and see if you'd be interested in contracting with Northrock Service Group, one of the top rated private security firms in the system.

If you are, the first step would be to complete a pro tem suspect apprehension. It's less of an evaluation and more of a chance to make sure that we can have a good working relationship. 

The suspect you would be after is known as [TARGET NAME]. They are known to be particularly elusive so you may have your work cut out for you.

Hope to hear from you soon, 

Braden Corchado
Logistics Officer - Stanton Branch
Northrock Service Group

missions.name: PU_PVP_Bounty_Stanton_NorthRock_General_ReHiring
missions.title: Pro Tem Suspect Apprehension (Reevaluation)
missions.description:
Hey again,

It's been a little while, hope everything's okay. I know things didn't end on the best terms, but after discussing it with management, I would like to offer you an opportunity to redeem yourself. You had potential and I hate to think that you didn't have a proper chance to show what you're capable of.

Apprehend [TARGET NAME] and we can see about getting your employment status reinstated.

Braden Corchado
Logistics Officer - Stanton Branch
Northrock Service Group

missions.name: PU_PVP_Bounty_Stanton_NorthRock_PrisonEscapee
missions.title: Escapee Bounty Assignment: [TARGET NAME]
missions.description:
Convicted criminal [TARGET NAME] has escaped from a local rehab facility and Northrock's been contracted to return the inmate to custody. In my experience, escaped prisoners tend not to give up peacefully, so use any method you can to find and subdue the escapee. 

Might be worth staking out spots where they could attempt to hack their record clean. Wouldn't be the first time a prisoner has tried to wipe their sentence after escaping.

Good hunting,

Braden Corchado
Logistics Officer - Stanton Branch
Northrock Service Group

missions.name: PU_PVP_Bounty_Stanton_NorthRock_PrisonEscapee_Intro
missions.title: Pro Tem Escapee Bounty Contract
missions.description:
Hey There,

My name is Braden Corchado and I'm a logistics officer for Northrock Service Group, the leading independently-owned security firm operating in the Stanton system. I may have reached out already, but we try to make it a point of approaching anyone who meets our high standards and encouraging them to complete a pro tem contract. 

You can't do much better than become a Northrock contractor. We have a solid reputation for offering challenging and interesting work at a higher rate of pay then many of our competitors in system. 

Now, to get approved, you will need to apprehend one [TARGET NAME]. They have recently escaped from the detention center and your job will be to track them down before they can disappear completely off the grid. 

A little hint is that it's safe to assume that the target is going to go try to clear their record. I recommend triangulating your search between the detention center they escaped from and locations where they can hack into the record system.

Get this done and we'll see about getting you more work.

Hope to hear from you soon, 

Braden Corchado
Logistics Officer - Stanton Branch
Northrock Service Group

missions.name: PU_PVP_Bounty_Stanton_NorthRock_PrisonEscapee_ReHiring
missions.title: Pro Tem Escapee Bounty Contract (Reevaluation)
missions.description:
Hey,

I know it's been a little while, but if you are still interested in doing contract work for Northrock, I convinced the management to give you a reevaluation. If you can successfully complete a bounty for us, we can see about getting your employment status reinstated.

This pro tem contract is to track down escaped criminal [TARGET NAME]. Try your best to get to them before they can wipe their record at database access point or the job's going to be significantly more difficult.

Hoping we can trust you on this.
 
Braden Corchado
Logistics Officer - Stanton Branch
Northrock Service Group

missions.name: PU_RetrieveConsignment
missions.title: Defend Site and Retrieve Confidential Materials
missions.description:
HURSTON DYNAMICS
OUTSOURCING DEPARTMENT

CONTRACT: Facility Sweep & Package Retrieval
CONTRACTOR AFFILIATION: Independent
OUTSOURCE MANAGER: G. Livingston
RISK ASSESSMENT: High
RUSH CONTRACT: Yes

Hurston has learned that the Nine Tails are attacking [LOCATION]. Our on-site forces have suffered heavy casualties and stopped responding to comms. Initial reports indicated that the gang was attempting to obtain confidential material recently delivered to the facility. Thankfully, we have security measures in place that should give us time to respond. We need an operative to head to the facility immediately, retrieve those boxes, and deliver them to a secure location.

You and whatever backup you choose to bring are authorized to take any actions necessary when confronting the trespassers. Suspects are considered armed and dangerous. Hurston will not provide material support and/or updates regarding the status of the facility's security forces. 

The confidential materials were discreetly delivered alongside other boxes in a consignment and locked in our automated vault with access codes kept on datapads held by senior security staff. However, there’s a strong chance Nine Tails may already have gotten their hands on them. You’ll need to find those datapads and then enter the codes at the package conveyor to retrieve the confidential materials. Payment will be sent once they have been delivered to [DROPOFF1]. 


** The information transmitted may contain confidential and/or privileged material. Any review, retransmission, dissemination, or other use of or taking action in reliance upon this information by persons or entities other than the intended recipient is prohibited. **

missions.name: PU_RetrieveConsignment_Pyro_CFP
missions.title: Confidential Material Stolen
missions.description:
You available for a job? One of our secure locations got hit by outlaws and some highly confidential material was stolen. As you can imagine, Citizens for Prosperity is eager to recover them as soon as possible.

Thanks to a local contact, we were able to trace the outlaws back to [LOCATION] where they're storing the confidential materials inside a secure automated vault. To access it, you’ll need to first find the relevant retrieval code and enter it at the vault’s package conveyor. Our best guess is that one of outlaw leaders will be carrying the code on their person so there is a very strong chance you’ll have to engage with them directly to get it.
  
Once you’ve gotten possession of the confidential material, we want you to deliver it to [DROPOFF1].

You’ll be making a big difference to a lot of people if you manage to pull this off.

Thanks in advance,

Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity

missions.name: PU_RetrieveConsignment_Illegal
missions.title: get the goods
missions.description:
Oh hello, I recently overheard a little bit of intel that [LOCATION] received some confidential materials that are of great interest to an acquaintance of mine. So interesting that they’re willing to pay for someone to storm the facility, grab the goods, and deliver them to [DROP OFF1]. Now I expect there to be plenty of security, who will most likely put up a fight, so I’d bring a gun or two. 

Word is the confidential materials were delivered in a consignment alongside other stuff and are now being stored in the facility’s automated vault. Senior security officers on-site carry datapads containing retrieval codes used to access the vault. You’ll have to get your hands on a datapad before using the package conveyor to retrieve the boxes. 

If you need a little sweetener, I’ve seen the manifest and can confirm that the other crates being stored at the facility are pretty choice. My client could care less about what happens to them, so they’re yours to do as you please. Run this right and those extra crates could be a nice bonus on top of the delivery fee for you.

missions.name: PU_ShipHijacked_Rclmr_Retrieve_Datapad
missions.title: Failed Negotiations
missions.description:
Ran into a bit of crap luck that I'm hoping you can help me right.

A few days ago, I hired the crew of the 'Pride of Arliss' to obtain some important data for me. They pulled off the job no problem, but the bastard of a captain comm'd me demanding more credits. Turns out it wasn't the first time he's tried to pull this trick either because in middle of "negotiating" with me, his ship was attacked by some very pissed off individuals looking to teach him a lesson.

Our comm got cut off when the shooting started and that was the last I heard from him. I'm guessing he's as good as ghosted, but I want you to head to the Pride of Arliss and try to get my data off the captain's personal datapad.

Once you have it, I set up a secure transmission channel at the ARC-L1 rest stop. Travel there and when you're in range, submit the data to me through this contract to get paid.
  
Don’t try to screw me over either. Karma can be a real asshole.

missions.name: PU_ShipHijacked_Rclmr_Unlawfull_Delivery
missions.title: Breach and Steal
missions.description:
Hey there. 

Nine Tails got themselves a little problem. As it turns out, they got a little side biz in the underground organ trade. Now that an area I generally like to steer well clear of, but a gig’s a gig, right? It seems that one of their mobile butcher shops aboard the 'October Rising' got pinched by private security while out chopping. Now the Nine Tails are willing to cut ties with the ship and its crew (who are probably all dead anyway), but they need a particular crate extracted. Guess it was a special order or something.

Anyway, get aboard the October Rising, get the package, and get out.

Security’s still hanging around so watch yourself and maybe bring some friends, but remember, your priority is the package. If you're looking to save yourself some extra hassle, you could also black out the area by shutting down the nearest comm array if you want to avoid the crimestats for, you know, killing a bunch of a security. But hey, you do you.

Once you’re out, drop the package off at the clinic on Grim HEX and I’ll sort your payment.

Easy peasy,

Ruto

missions.title: URGENT: Retake Security Post Kareah
missions.description:
Security Post Kareah is under attack by an unknown number of assailants. 

Crusader is seeking contractors to quickly travel to the station and eliminate all trespassers in the vicinity before our security forces are overwhelmed.  

We’re not sure whether the attackers are targeting the contraband in our evidence lockup or our CrimeStat database, but whatever they’re after, they need to be dealt with. You will receive a combat bonus for each target neutralized.  

By accepting this contract, you agree to abide by all Crusader Security protocols: If you harm any guards or other authorized contractors while on the station, your contract will be terminated and you will be marked as a target. 

Time is of the essence, but make sure you’re well equipped to handle the hostiles before responding. 

CONTRACT AUTHORIZED BY: 
Liaison Officer Bautista 
ID# 948J030K
